description:
**Company:** N.R. Engineering Industries

**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu (On\-site / Factory\-based)

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Experience Required:** 5–8 years in Manufacturing, Engineering, or Industrial Plant HR

**Salary Range:** ₹25,000 – ₹30,000 per month (Based on experience and capability)

**Job Summary**

N.R. Engineering Industries is seeking a strong, resilient, and highly disciplined **HR Manager** to lead our human resources department and drive plant\-wide operational excellence.

We are currently transitioning into a high\-performance culture backed by strict discipline, productivity matrices, and accountability. We are not looking for a passive administrator; we need a dynamic, firm, and legally sound HR leader who can enforce company policies, manage grievances effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Policy Enforcement \& Discipline:** Enforce plant rules regarding punctuality, shift attendance, workplace discipline, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* **Performance Matrix Management:** Own and maintain the monthly performance tracking database (tracking employee KPIs, attendance points, and compliance logs) to determine monthly incentives.
* **Strict Recruitment \& Verification:** Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for office staff and factory floor labor, ensuring 100% mandatory background checks, reference checks, and certificate verification.
* **Statutory \& Labor Compliance:** Ensure flawless compliance with factory acts, labor laws, PF, ESI, and local industrial regulations in Coimbatore.
* **Grievance Handling \& Conflict Resolution:** Act as a fair but firm bridge between management and the factory floor, handling disputes and maintaining a productive work environment under high\-pressure timelines.
* **Structured Onboarding \& Offboarding:** Implement strict notice period compliance, absconding policies, and flawless "No Dues Certificate" (NDC) processes before issuing relieving documentation.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Education:** MBA in HR or a postgraduate degree in Labor Welfare/Industrial Relations.
* **Experience:** **Minimum 5 years of core HR experience explicitly within a manufacturing plant or engineering environment.** Experience dealing with factory labor, line\-incharges, and department heads is mandatory.
* **Key Skills:** Excellent command over Tamil and English (written and verbal), strong knowledge of labor laws, conflict management, and high emotional resilience.
* **Personality:** Assertive, highly organized, comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where management sets aggressive growth targets, and capable of holding people accountable.

* Prevent penalties, interest, damages, and prosecution under labor laws
* Track exposure related to PF, ESI, wages, bonus, gratuity, and contract labor

KRA 3: Inspections, Audits \& Government Interface

**KPIs**

* No adverse inspection remarks escalated to litigation stage
* 100% audit observations closed within agreed timelines

* Audit contractor payroll, attendance, PF/ESI, and wage payments
* Eliminate principal employer risk

**KPIs**

* 100% contractor compliance coverage
* Zero PF/ESI or wage liability transferred to company
* Contractor audit reports completed quarterly

KRA 5: Legal Escalation \& Litigation Management

**Responsibilities**

* Draft and respond to show\-cause notices, inspection reports, and legal notices
* Coordinate with legal counsel for conciliation, labor court, and tribunal matters
* Escalate high\-risk matters with impact analysis

**KPIs**

* Timely response to 100% legal notices
* Reduction in active labor litigation cases

* Oversee payroll accuracy and statutory deductions

**KPIs**

* Zero payroll\-related statutory errors

* Payroll audit score ≥ 99% accuracy

* Draft, update, and enforce legally compliant HR policies

* Internal audit compliance score ≥ 95%

title: Audit Associate – Statutory Audit
description:
Position : Audit Associate – Statutory Audit  

Department : Statutory Audit  

Employment type: Full\-time  

Positions: 1  

Qualification: Qualified CA (freshers welcome)  

Location : Hyderabad  

Experience : 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome  

Reporting To: Audit Manager / Engagement Partner


About Us


KVA is a boutique\-chartered accounting and advisory firm based in Hyderabad, with a legacy of over 40 years. Over the years, we have grown to become one of the leading firms in the city, serving a diverse set of clients across industries.


We operate within a strong global and sector\-focused ecosystem. Through our association with DFK International, we are connected to member firms across \~90 countries, enabling us to support clients on complex cross\-border matters. We are also closely aligned with Sathguru Management Consultants, bringing deep expertise in the life sciences sector and enhancing the value we deliver to clients in this space.


As a group of \~200 professionals, we work with businesses across India and internationally. While we continue to provide core audit and tax services, a significant part of our practice today focuses on high\-value advisory, including international taxation, structuring, and M\&A.


Role Description


We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to join our Statutory Audit team in Hyderabad. The role involves working on end\-to\-end audit engagements for companies across industries, supporting the team in delivering high\-quality, compliant audits. It is a strong launchpad for a recently qualified CA, with direct exposure to clients, financial statements, and the full audit lifecycle.


Key Roles and Responsibilities  



* Execute substantive and analytical audit procedures under the guidance of seniors and managers.
* Vouch and verify transactions, test internal controls, and document working papers as per firm and SA (Standards on Auditing) requirements.
* Assist in preparation and review of financial statements as per applicable framework (Ind AS / AS) and Schedule III of the Companies Act, 2013
* Perform ledger scrutiny, ratio analysis, and identify unusual or high\-risk transactions.
* Support compliance checks across Income Tax, GST, TDS, and Companies Act requirements relevant to the audit.
* Maintain audit documentation and ensure timely closure of assigned sections.
* Coordinate with client finance teams to obtain data, reconciliations, and supporting evidence.
* Flag observations and potential audit issues to seniors promptly.


Qualification \& Eligibility  



* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) (recently cleared, both groups)
* Experience: 1 year of post\-qualification experience; freshers welcome
* Completed articleship in audit/assurance preferred.


Skills  



* Sound knowledge of statutory audit procedures and applicable financial reporting frameworks (Ind AS / AS)
* Strong grasp of Standards on Auditing and the Companies Act, 2013
* Proficiency in MS Excel and working knowledge of accounting/audit software (Tally, audit tools, etc.)
* Attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a methodical approach to documentation.
* Good written and verbal communication; ability to interact professionally with clients.
* Willingness to travel for fieldwork and to meet engagement deadlines.


What We Offer  



* Structured exposure to diverse audit engagements and industries
* Mentorship from experienced managers and partners
* A collaborative team environment with clear growth pathways

**Compliance Monitoring and Auditing:**

* Ensure the company complies with all relevant local, national, and international labour laws, including health and safety regulations, employee compensation, wage and hour laws, and anti\-discrimination laws.

**Policy Development and Implementation:**

* Develop, update, and maintain HR policies and procedures in accordance with the latest labour laws and industry standards.

**Training and Education:**

description:
**Reporting to:** Director / Operations Head  
**Experience:** **3 years in a factory manager / plant head role (HVAC, heat pumps, refrigeration, chillers or similar preferred)**

The Factory Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end management of Sunniva Heatpumps’ manufacturing unit, ensuring safe, efficient, and quality\-focused production as per monthly and annual business plans.

Key responsibilities

* Plan, organize and control daily production to meet output, quality, and dispatch targets for heat pump products (domestic and commercial).
* Prepare and execute monthly and weekly production plans in coordination with sales, purchase, and stores, ensuring material availability and minimal line stoppages.
* Implement and monitor standard operating procedures (SOPs) for assembly, brazing, leak testing, charging, electrical testing, and final inspection of heat pumps.
* Ensure adherence to quality standards, manage in\-process and final inspection, and drive reduction in rework, rejection, and field failures.
* Lead factory manpower: deploy operators across lines, approve shift schedules, monitor productivity, and handle basic IR/HR issues in coordination with HR.
* Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery, tools, and test rigs, ensuring high uptime of critical equipment.
* Drive safety culture on shop floor: enforce PPE usage, safe handling of refrigerants and electrical equipment, and compliance with factory and statutory norms.
* Monitor and control manufacturing cost: productivity, overtime, scrap, consumables, and utilities; support cost\-reduction and efficiency\-improvement projects.
* Maintain accurate production records, WIP, and finished goods data in ERP (e.g., Odoo) and generate daily/weekly/monthly MIS for management.
* Coordinate with purchase and stores for incoming material planning, GRN issues, and resolution of shortages or quality problems.
* Support NPD/engineering team during proto builds, pilot runs, and engineering changes; ensure smooth implementation on the line.
* Ensure housekeeping (5S), layout discipline, and continuous improvement / lean initiatives across the factory.
* Liaise with external agencies (calibration, statutory inspectors, contractors) and support compliance with all applicable regulations and audits.

Required qualifications

* Diploma / BE in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, or Industrial Engineering (ITI with long experience can be considered for smaller plant).
* **3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably HVAC, refrigeration, or heat pump assembly plants.**
* Strong knowledge of production planning, quality systems, and basic maintenance practices.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems (preferably Odoo or similar) for production, inventory, and reporting.
* Good understanding of safety, 5S, and basic lean / continuous improvement tools.
* Ability to lead and motivate shop\-floor teams, handle multi\-skill operators, and coordinate with cross\-functional departments.
* Basic MS Excel, email, and documentation skills for MIS, reporting, and communication.

Key skills and competencies

* Strong **leadership** and people\-management skills with a hands\-on, on\-the\-shop\-floor approach.
* Problem\-solving mindset for production bottlenecks, quality issues, and resource constraints.
* Result orientation with focus on on\-time delivery, first\-pass yield, and cost control.
* Good communication and coordination skills with management, vendors, and internal teams.
* Discipline, integrity, and ability to work under pressure in a growing manufacturing setup.

KPIs / performance metrics

* Monthly production vs. plan (units and value).​
* First\-pass yield, in\-process and final rejections, and customer complaints.​
* Machine uptime and maintenance compliance.
* Productivity per person and overtime percentage.​
* Safety incidents, near misses, and audit observations.

title: Product Data Executive
description:
**About Qwikxy**

Qwikxy is a fast\-growing e\-commerce platform focused on delivering a seamless product discovery and purchase experience. Our catalogue team is the backbone of what customers see — accurate, complete, and well\-structured product data is critical to our success.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, detail\-oriented fresher to join our catalogue team as a Product Data Executive. In this role, you will be responsible for creating, verifying, and managing product listings on the Qwikxy platform — ensuring every product is accurately represented, correctly categorised, and error\-free before going live.

**Role Title**

Product Data Executive

**Department**

Catalogue \& Product Operations

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time

**Experience**

Fresher (0–1 year)

**Location**

Bengaluru, Karnataka (On\-site)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create and upload detailed product listings on the Qwikxy platform, ensuring all attributes (title, description, category, price, images, SKU, specifications) are accurately captured.
* Maintain and update Excel\-based product master sheets, using advanced features such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation to track and manage catalogue data.
* Analyse end\-to\-end product data flow — from source input to live display on the website — and identify where data might break, get mis formatted, or fail to reflect correctly on the frontend.
* Coordinate with the backend/tech team to understand how product data is processed through the system (APIs, database fields, mapping logic) and flag inconsistencies or data mismatches proactively.
* Perform thorough QA checks on uploaded products to ensure zero display errors, broken attributes, or missing fields on the live platform.
* Build and maintain structured reports and dashboards in Excel to track upload progress, error rates, and catalogue health metrics.
* Document standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product creation workflows to ensure consistency across the team.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with the tech, design, and business teams to resolve data issues quickly.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in any discipline (BCA, B.Tech, or any equivalent qualification preferred).**
* **Proficiency in:** Advanced Microsoft Excel:

◦ Formulas: VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, INDEX\-MATCH, IFERROR, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS

◦ Pivot Tables \& Charts for data summarisation and reporting

◦ Data Validation, Conditional Formatting, and Drop\-down Lists

◦ Power Query or basic Macros (good to have)

* **Foundational understanding of:** Web \& Backend Basics:

◦ How websites and web applications work (frontend vs backend)

◦ What APIs are and how data flows between systems

◦ Basic familiarity with JSON/XML data structures (ability to read, not necessarily code)

◦ Understanding of database concepts like fields, records, and data types

* **Ability to spot discrepancies in large datasets and product information.** Attention to Detail
* **Capable of tracing a data issue back to its root cause systematically.** Logical Reasoning
* **Comfortable picking up new tools, platforms, and internal systems with minimal hand\-holding.** Quick Learner
* **Clear written and verbal communication to coordinate with tech and business stakeholders.** Communication

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to e\-commerce platforms (Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Shopify, etc.)
* Basic knowledge of HTML or how product attributes render on a web page
* Familiarity with Google Sheets and collaboration tools like Notion or Confluence
* Experience with any PIM (Product Information Management) tool

**What We Offer**

* A high\-ownership role from Day 1 — your work directly impacts what customers see on the platform.
* Exposure to the full product operations lifecycle in a high\-growth e\-commerce environment.
* Mentorship from experienced catalogue and tech leads.
* Structured learning path with clear growth milestones.
* Competitive fresher compensation.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹23,000\.00 per month

Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)

* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation

* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks

* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver  



  

1\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score

We are looking for **highly motivated MBA freshers and fresh graduates** who wish to kickstart their career in the Talent Acquisition domain with structured learning, strong mentorship, and a clear path toward career advancement.

**Your Growth Path:**

Your growth here is simple: the more smoothly you manage the hiring process and support successful onboardings, the faster you grow.

* **Weeks 1–2: Getting Started:** You quickly settle into our processes, begin sourcing for active roles, and support candidates through the early stages of the funnel — contributing to onboarding readiness from the start.

description:
### **Sr. Executive Human Resource – US Payroll**

**Location:** Tolichowki, Hyderabad, Telangana  

**Company:** Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd.

### **About Us**


Harmony United Medsolutions Pvt. Ltd. (HUMS) is a rapidly growing healthcare management company supporting US\-based healthcare operations. With over nine years of experience in medical billing, AR management, and healthcare support services, we proudly partner with Harmony United Psychiatric Care (HUPC), a US healthcare organization.


We are currently looking for a dynamic HR professional with strong US Payroll experience to join our team in Hyderabad and contribute to our expanding HR operations, payroll management, and talent support functions.

### **Position Overview**


The **Sr. Executive – US Payroll** will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end US payroll processing for employees, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution. In addition to payroll responsibilities, the role will also support recruitment activities and other HR tasks assigned by the reporting manager. This role is ideal for professionals looking to build a strong career in international payroll management, HR operations, and talent acquisition support.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Payroll Responsibilities:**  

* Manage end\-to\-end US payroll processing and ensure timely salary disbursement
* Handle payroll inputs, validations, and monthly payroll reconciliation
* Ensure compliance with US payroll regulations and company policies
* Coordinate with finance and HR teams for payroll updates and corrections
* Maintain employee payroll records and update changes in HRMS/payroll systems
* Prepare payroll reports, summaries, and audit documentation
* Address employee payroll queries and resolve discrepancies
* Ensure accuracy and confidentiality of payroll data
**Recruitment \& HR Support:**  

* Support end\-to\-end recruitment activities including sourcing, screening, and coordinating interviews
* Assist in posting job openings across recruitment platforms
* Maintain candidate records and recruitment trackers
* Coordinate onboarding and joining formalities for new hires
* Support HR operations and employee engagement activities
**Additional Responsibilities:**  

* Perform any HR\-related tasks assigned by the reporting manager
* Support cross\-functional HR activities as per business requirements
### **Requirements**

* 2–5 years of experience in HR Payroll or US Payroll processing
* Experience in healthcare payroll or US\-based payroll systems is preferred
* Exposure to recruitment or HR generalist activities is an added advantage
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, tax concepts, and compliance
* Good communication and analytical skills
* Experience working with HRMS/ATS or payroll tools
* Master’s degree in Human Resources, MBA HR, Finance, or related field

### **Work Location \& Timing (Strict Requirement)**

* Location: Tolichowki, Hyderabad
* Shift: Night Shift
* Work Schedule: Monday – Thursday
* Work Hours: 4:45 PM to 3:45 AM IST (Strict timing)

### **Benefits**

* Competitive salary package (including EPF and PF)
* Health Insurance
* 4\-Day Work Week (Monday – Thursday)
* Career growth and professional development opportunities
* Additional benefits including food and cab\-drop facility

title: Assistant Human Resources Manager- Department Head
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26070332  

**Job Category**Human Resources  

**Location**Jai Singh Highway, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India, 302016  

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



Assists in carrying out the daily activities of the Human Resource Office including recruitment, total compensation, and training and development. Additionally, he/she assists in delivering HR services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success; as well as ensuring compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and operating procedures.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Assisting in Managing Recruitment and Hiring Process**


* Assists in the interviewing and hiring of Human Resource employee team members with the appropriate skills, as needed.


* Assists in establishing and maintains contact with external recruitment sources.


* Attends job fairs and ensures documentation of outreach efforts in accordance with Human Resource Standard Operating Procedures.


* Networks with local organizations (e.g., Hotel Association and peers) to source candidates for current or future openings.


* Assists in monitoring candidate identification and selection process.


* Performs quality control on candidate identification/selection.

  



**Assisting in Administering and Educating Employee Benefits**


* Works with the unemployment services provider to respond to unemployment claims; reviews provider reports for accuracy and corrects errors.


* Assists with unemployment claim activity reports.


* Attends unemployment hearings and ensures property is properly represented, as needed.

  



**Assisting in Managing Employee Development**


* Assists with departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.


* Ensures employees are cross\-trained to support successful daily operations.


* Assists with coordination and facilitation of new hire orientation program to generate a positive first impression for employees and emphasize the importance of guest service in company culture.


* Ensures attendance by all new hires and participation of the leadership team in training programs


* Assists with ensuring departmental orientation processes are in place and employees receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

  



**Assisting in Maintaining Employee Relations**


* Assists in maintaining effective employee communication channels in the property (e.g., develops daily communications and assists with regularly scheduled property\-wide meetings).


* Reviews progressive discipline documentation for accuracy and consistency, and checks for supportive documentation and is accountable for determining appropriate action.


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to acknowledge employee problems or concerns in a timely manner


* Ensures employee issues are referred to the Department Manager for resolution or escalated to the Director of Human Resources/Multi\-Property Director of Human Resources.


* Partners with Loss Prevention to conduct employee accident investigations, as necessary.


* Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

  



**Assisting in Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Assists with ensuring employee files contain required employment paperwork, proper performance management and compensation documentation, are properly maintained and secured for the required length of time.


* Assists with ensuring compliance with procedure for accessing, reviewing, and auditing employee files and ensure compliance with the Privacy Act.


* Assists with ensuring medical records are maintained in a separate, secure and confidential medical file.


* Facilitates random, reasonable belief and post accident drug testing process (in properties where applicable).


* Communicates property rules and regulations via the employee handbook.


* Assists with ensuring all safety and security policies (e.g., property removal, lost and found items, blood borne pathogens, accident reporting, and hygiene) are communicated to employees on a regular basis through orientation, property meetings, bulletin boards, etc.


* Assists with periodic claims reviews with Regional Claims office to ensure claims are closed in a timely manner and reserve levels are appropriate for open claims.


* Assists with managing Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and manage costs.

description:
**About Arbolus**


Arbolus is the next\-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable, and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.  

  

At the core of our platform is the world’s largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment, and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world’s leading software assets.  

  

Since 2018, we’ve redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech\-driven approach that delivers high\-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the **Arbolus Customer Review Library**, **Canopy, our market\-first automated Q\&A tool**, and our unmatched standard of client service, because great technology should always be backed by great people.  

  

Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture\-backed scale\-up with 170\+ employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, New York, and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.

 **About the role**


The Professional Services team is right at the core of Arbolus, and is responsible for providing best\-in\-class service to our clients around the world.


As an Associate in the Professional Services team, you will research a wide variety of topics and sectors and you will recruit and establish connections with thought leaders around the world.


In this role, you will start gaining exposure and establishing relationships with Arbolus clients, helping them make well\-informed business decisions by connecting with Arbolus experts.

 **Key responsibilities you will be in charge of**

* Build and develop relationships with Arbolus clients through project execution, phone/in\-person client meetings, and overall account management.
* Provide day\-to\-day support on client projects.
* Balance multiple, concurrent, time\-sensitive research requests.
* Responsible for sourcing and recruiting leading experts based on client needs, utilizing online research and networking.
* Screening new and existing experts via phone and email to ensure project relevance.
* Onboarding new experts to the Arbolus platform.
* Develop relationships with thought leaders and experts across a variety of industries.
* Close collaboration with Senior Associates, Project Leads, and Account Managers across international teams.

**About you**


We are looking for curious and ambitious people who are eager to learn to achieve success and contribute to Arbolus’ business growth.  

  



**Requirements to succeed in this role**

* Strong academic background: Finance, Business, HR, Research, Economics
* Min. of 0\-1 years of experience
* A proven entrepreneurial/commercial drive
* Experience/Confidence in cold outreach and outbound calls
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Desire to work in a sourcing/lead generation type of role and ability to work in a fast\-paced, results\-oriented environment
* **Prior experience working night shifts or interacting with US clients is a strong plus.**

#### **This is a remote role (100% WFH after first 2 months being work from office training period 9am\-6pm), Shift timings after training period will be nine hours anytime between 6 pm to 6 am.**

**Please only apply for this position if you are fine with the work timings.**

 **Nice to have**

* Previous experience in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment
* Familiar with the expert\-networking industry
* Intellectual curiosity and desire to learn

* Uncapped bonus on top of your base salary
* Comprehensive health insurance
* Top\-notch equipment to make our work efficient and smooth

title: Talent Acquisition Senior Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------


We are seeking an independent, highly proactive **Senior Clinical Recruiter** for a **1\-year fixed\-term contract** to completely own and manage the end\-to\-end talent acquisition function for Fresenius Medical Care in India.


As a **sole contributor for the country**, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing all clinical and operational hiring across our pan\-India dialysis network. Operating from India, you will report directly to the **Talent Acquisition Manager based in the Philippines**. This role requires a seasoned recruiter who thrives in a standalone capacity, comfortably balancing strategic alignment with stakeholders across India and cross\-border reporting lines.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* **Standalone TA ownership:** act as the sole point of contact for all recruitment activities in India, managing the full\-cycle recruitment process for clinical roles (Dialysis Nurses, Nephrologists, Resident Medical Officers, and Technicians) from sourcing to offer closure.
* **Cross\-border reporting:** maintain seamless, regular alignment with the regional Talent Acquisition Manager based in the Philippines, providing clear visibility into the country's hiring pipelines, market challenges, and local metrics.
* **Pan\-India Stakeholder management:** partner directly with local Center Managers, Head Nurses, and Consultant Nephrologists across different states to understand hiring needs and ensure selection alignment.
* **End\-to\-End sourcing \& execution:** independently execute candidate sourcing using specialized channels (Naukri, LinkedIn, healthcare job portals, local networks, and employee referrals) without agency reliance wherever possible.
* **Pipeline \& attrition management:** build and maintain a robust talent pool of qualified clinical professionals to aggressively manage and mitigate center attrition within a highly competitive market.
* **Employer Branding \& institutional partnerships:** represent the company independently at career fairs, Indian Nursing Council (INC) recognized campus events, and paramedical institutes to secure a steady flow of graduate talent.
* **Hiring Manager advisory:** provide expert talent market guidance to local hiring managers regarding regional salary benchmarks, talent availability, and effective interview techniques.
* **Market Intelligence \& strategy:** proactively assess regional market conditions in India (specifically Tier\-2 and Tier\-3 talent dynamics) to identify talent shortages and implement creative localized sourcing techniques.
* **Compliance \& credentialing:** ensure all independent recruitment activities strictly adhere to global company policies and Indian regulatory frameworks, managing background verification (BGV) and state nursing/medical council registrations.
* **Data \& KPI tracking:** independently track and report on key recruitment metrics, translating data into actionable insights for regional TA leadership in the Philippines.

**Our Requirements**
--------------------

* **Experience:** **5\+ years of core experience in recruitment/talent acquisition**, with a proven track record of managing high\-volume recruitment within India, preferably in healthcare (nurses and clinical support)
* **Work environment Fit:** proven experience working as a **sole contributor** or in an autonomous, standalone capacity. Prior experience reporting into a **remote or cross\-border manager** is highly desirable.
* **Contract Commitment:** Ability to commit to a **1\-year fixed\-term contract** with a focus on immediate impact and self\-driven execution.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Healthcare Administration, Master of Health Administration (MHA), MBA in HR, or a related field.
* **Language Skills:** Fluency in **English** and **Hindi** is mandatory for day\-to\-day operations and cross\-border reporting. Knowledge of additional regional languages is a distinct advantage.
* **Skills:** Exceptional organizational and time\-management skills, strong negotiation capabilities, and the resilience needed to manage country\-wide hiring pressures single\-handedly.


Area Preference: Gurgaon/Delhi/Noida/NCR

description:
**Job Title:** Security Officer  

**Department:** Operations – Manned Guarding  

**Reports To:** Site In\-charge / Assignment Manager / Branch Operations Manager  

**Company:** G4S Secure Solutions (India) Pvt. Ltd.


**Contact Information**:


* **Contact Person**: Abhay Mulik

* **Mobile**: \+91 9972877452

* **WhatsApp**: \+91 9113627282

* **Email**: abhay.mulik@in.g4s.com

  



### **Position Summary:**



The **Security Officer** acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**


**1\. Site Command and Control:**


* Function as the second\-in\-command or site head (depending on site size).
  


* Lead and monitor all security operations at the designated client site.
  


* Ensure guards follow all post duties, site\-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
  



**2\. Team Supervision:**


* Supervise the deployment and performance of Security Supervisors and Guards.
  


* Conduct daily muster, uniform inspection, and tool checks.
  


* Address absenteeism, disciplinary issues, and performance shortfalls.
  



**3\. Client Coordination:**


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client at the site.
  


* Conduct regular meetings with client representatives to address concerns or updates.
  


* Ensure client satisfaction through prompt issue resolution and quality service delivery.
  



**4\. Operational Execution:**


* Ensure access control systems, patrolling routines, visitor management, and asset protection are functioning as per SOP.
  


* Monitor surveillance systems and review CCTV footage in coordination with client security teams.
  


* Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
  



**5\. Incident Management:**


* Act promptly in case of incidents like theft, fire, medical emergencies, or safety violations.
  


* Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
  


* File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
  



**6\. Documentation \& Reporting:**


* Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
  


* Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
  


* Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit\-ready.
  



**7\. Training \& Compliance:**


* Conduct on\-the\-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
  


* Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.
  


* Support HR and compliance teams during audits, inspections, or client reviews.

  



### **Eligibility Criteria:**


* **Education:** Minimum 12th Pass; Graduate preferred.
  


* **Experience:**  



	+ 4–8 years of experience in the security industry, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or officer\-level role.
	  
	
	
	+ Background in defence/police/paramilitary preferred.
* **Age:** 28 to 50 years (Flexible for ex\-servicemen).
  


* **Physical Standards:** Fit and alert; Minimum height 170 cm.

  



### **Key Skills \& Attributes:**


* Strong leadership and coordination skills.
  


* Good written and verbal communication (English, Hindi, and local language).
  


* Proficiency in report writing, basic computer use (MS Office, email).
  


* Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.
  


* Ability to handle pressure and work rotational shifts.

  



### **Working Conditions:**


* Site\-based duty with 8/12\-hour shifts depending on deployment.
  


* 6\-day work week or rotational off, as per duty schedule.
  


* Uniform, mobile phone (if applicable), ID card, and duty gear provided.
  


* PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, leave benefits, and insurance as per statutory norms.

  



### **Remuneration:**


* As per G4S internal grade structure and prevailing **Minimum Wages for Security Officer/Supervisor category** in the respective state/UT.
  


* Site\-based allowances, night duty allowance, and performance incentives may apply.

  



### **Career Path within G4S:**



Security Officer Site In\-charge Assignment Manager Area Operations Officer Regional Operations Manager

title: HR Shared Service Employee Experience Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

As our NielsenIQ HR Organization continues to evolve to meet the changing demands of the business and the workforce, we will be challenged to find new ways to deliver value to the organization with a focus on efficiency and simplicity. To enable this transformation, we will set up a new Employee Experience team to focus on delivering with excellence against our most fundamental HR needs. Employee Experience team members will work with the Regional/Cluster/Country Employee Experience leader, ensuring we deliver excellence in HR operations and administrative work and improve the overall employee experience.

**In this role you will:**

* Ensure continuity of business as usual (BAU) HR operations and administrative work for your assigned cluster/country
* Ensure our employees’ most fundamental needs are met by effectively answering employee queries, maintaining accurate employee data and connecting associates with the right tools
* Ensure best in class service when it comes to HR administrative processes
* Identify and document local and cluster level administrative work pertaining to standard letters, documents, and agreements
* Identify and document any additional administrative and operational work currently owned by local, regional, and global HRBPs and COEs which could move into the Employee Experience team
* Review our policies, processes, and ways of working holistically for opportunities to streamline – eliminate waste and redundancy
* Propose improvements to internal processes with an eye towards automation, enabling more consistency across the HR and the NielsenIQ business (both locally and globally)
* Research and bring latest practices in the cluster/country to the team
* Stay connected with the other Employee Experience team members, ensuring that we take a consistent approach wherever possible and avoid duplication of effort or regionally varied processes
* Implement systems/automation\-based solutions for the organization
* Support the transition of repeatable and scalable HR activities into Tier 1 teams, enabling local teams to focus on specialized, high\-impact work while ensuring seamless escalation and handoff for complex issues.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of standardized work by identifying opportunities to streamline, automate, and document processes, reducing variation and duplication of effort.
* Collaborate with global and local Employee Experience colleagues to embed best practices, maintain strong governance, and uphold service level agreements for all standardized support activities.
* Deliver HR services using standardized processes, templates, and tools to ensure consistency, reliability, and a best\-in\-class employee experience across all regions and teams.

title: Junior Automation AI Engineer
description:
**Join Our Team of Enthusiasts!**  

  

At KVALITO Consulting Group, a woman\-owned business founded in 2013, we are dedicated to transforming the life sciences and healthcare sectors through tailored, innovative solutions that prioritize quality and people. Guided by our vision to lead with talent and transform with purpose, we are committed to creating lasting, high\-value relationships with our clients and empowering high\-performing individuals to reach their full potential.  

At KVALITO, we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our work, fostering a results\-oriented, ambitious, and caring culture. Our purpose\-driven team is agile and adaptable, ready to learn and respond to evolving business needs. Together, we champion a culture that balances excellence with empathy, utilizing technology and human\-centric approaches to drive impactful results.  

If you’re passionate about making a difference and eager to grow within a company that values inclusivity and high performance, KVALITO could be the place for you. Join us in creating transformative solutions that empower our clients and leave a legacy of excellence in consulting.
  

*Learn more about us at:* *www.kvalito.ch*  

  

  

**Junior Automation AI Engineer**  

  

  

**Position:** Junior Automation AI Engineer  

**Location:** Remote, India  

**Type:** Full\-Time/Trainee/Internship\-to\-hire  

**Experience:** 0\-2 years. Freshers are encouraged to apply.  

**Entry Point:** KVALITO Hiring Event, Hyderabad.  

  

  

**About the Hyderabad Hiring Event**  

This role is being filled through a dedicated hiring event in Hyderabad. The process is designed to be fast, fair, and based on what you can actually do, not just what is on your resume.  

  

**How the selection works:**
* Application: Along with your resume, submit your GitHub/GitLab or portfolio link, a short\-written answer to "Describe one process you would automate and why", your availability date, and your location. Do not hesitate to also attach examples of your projects (code, screenshots, demo videos, write\-ups, or anything that shows what you have built) directly with your application.
* Online logic and skills test (around 1 hour): If shortlisted, you take an online test covering logic, Python, and your understanding of automation and AI, plus a small practical challenge.
* Onsite live technical interview in Hyderabad: Top candidates are invited to a full\-day onsite event. You meet our team, walk through your work, and demonstrate hands\-on skills live.
* Use case problem\-solving interview: A final round focused on how you think, how you take ownership, and how you work with others to solve a real problem.


  

Selected candidates can join KVALITO through one of three paths: a full\-time role, a trainee program, or an internship\-to\-hire path. We agree on the right path with you based on your experience, readiness, and goals.  

  

**Who are you?**  

You are at the start of your career, and you are hungry to build things. You see a repetitive manual task and your first instinct is to ask whether a script, a workflow, or an AI agent could handle it. You enjoy figuring out how things work and you do not wait to be told to learn.  

  

You have some hands\-on experience, from university projects, internships, hackathons, open source, or personal projects, in at least one of the following:
* Python and general scripting, with a basic grasp of AI and LLM tools (OpenAI APIs, LangChain, prompt engineering, simple agents).
* The Microsoft automation stack (Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Dynamics 365\), or a clear willingness to learn it quickly.

You do not need to be an expert in both. We care that you have built something real in one of them and that you can show it. Strong fundamentals beat a long buzzword list.  

  

You communicate clearly in English. You ask good questions, you are honest about what you do not know, and you take ownership of your work. You do not disappear when something gets hard.  

  

You do not need prior experience in life sciences, pharma, or healthcare, and you are not expected to know GxP, GMP, or FDA regulations on day one. But you are curious about the industry we work in. Before the interview, you are expected to read about KVALITO and the life sciences sector and come with thoughtful questions.  

  

**What’s great about this role?**
* Real work from day one: You will contribute to projects that solve actual business problems for global life sciences and healthcare clients, not toy exercises.
* Modern automation and AI: You will work across Python, AI tooling, and the Microsoft Power Platform, and grow into the stack that fits your strengths.
* Mentorship and structured growth: You will be paired with senior consultants who review your work, give honest feedback, and help you level up fast.
* Three possible paths: Full\-time role, trainee program, or internship\-to\-hire. We pick the path with you based on where you are today.
* Flat hierarchy: You will work directly with leadership and senior consultants, not through layers of management.
* Truly remote: Work from anywhere in India. No office required, ever.


  

**What’s challenging about this role?**
* Regulated environments: Life sciences clients have strict validation and documentation rules. You will need to learn this on the job. It is real engineering work, not just paperwork.
* Ambiguity: Real problems rarely come with a clean spec. You will need to ask questions, push back, and propose options.
* High expectations: We are a small, high\-performance team. Junior does not mean low standards. You will be expected to grow fast and own your work.
* Remote self\-management: Working from home as a junior is harder than it sounds. You need discipline, structure, and the courage to speak up early when stuck.


  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Build automation and AI components under the guidance of senior engineers, using Python, AI/LLM tools, and/or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Participate in discovery sessions with clients and internal teams. Take notes, ask questions, and translate what you hear into clear technical tasks.
* Write clean, readable code and clear technical documentation.
* Test your work thoroughly before handing it over. Fix bugs you find and the ones reported back.
* Support integration work between automation workflows and enterprise systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and APIs.
* Help maintain and improve existing automation and AI components.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and risks proactively. Do not wait until the deadline to flag a problem.
* Learn the basics of working in regulated life sciences environments and apply them in your work.
* Continuously benchmark new Tech Trends
* Train and share knowledge with the team on new trends and technologies


  

**Key Qualifications:**
* 0 to 2 years of professional experience. Internships, freelance work, open\-source contributions, and significant personal or academic projects count.
* Bachelor’s degree (or final\-year student) in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also welcome.
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of: Python scripting and AI/LLM tooling, or Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Exposure to at least one major cloud platform (Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), through coursework, certifications, projects, or work experience.
* Solid understanding of programming fundamentals: data structures, control flow, functions, basic algorithms, and version control with Git.
* A public GitHub, GitLab, or portfolio with code or projects we can look at.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* Ability to learn quickly and willingness to take feedback seriously.
* Reliable, accountable, and proactive. You finish what you start.
* Willing to travel to Hyderabad for the onsite hiring event.


  

**Nice to have:**
* Experience with both Python/AI tooling and Microsoft Power Platform.
* Exposure to LLM applications, prompt engineering, RAG, or simple AI agents.
* Hands\-on project work on Azure (Logic Apps, Functions, OpenAI Service), AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, S3\), or Google Cloud (Cloud Functions, Vertex AI), or a cloud certification from any of the three.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or another ERP system.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
* Experience with API integrations.
* Curiosity about life sciences, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare. No prior industry knowledge is required, but you should come to the interview with questions and a basic understanding of what KVALITO does.
* Hackathon participation, open\-source contributions, or technical blog posts.
* Front\-end and back\-end development experience (e.g. Python, Node.js, React, or similar frameworks).


  

**Key Competencies:**
* Organizational Skills: Ability to manage complex scheduling and documentation requirements with precision.
* Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in documentation, ensuring all records comply with regulatory standards.
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust priorities and work efficiently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Problem\-Solving: Skilled in identifying potential compliance risks and implementing practical solutions.
* Relationship\-Building: Effectively collaborates with both internal and external stakeholders to foster alignment and support compliance goals.


  

**You:**
* Are driven by impact, passionate about shaping the future of Life Sciences and healthcare through technology and innovation.
* Believe in open communication, speak up, challenge ideas, and engage in meaningful discussions, even with leadership.
* Focus on solutions, not problems, take a proactive approach, looking for ways to improve rather than assigning blame.
* Own your work, take responsibility and accountability seriously, no matter how challenging the situation.
* Commit to excellence, delivering high\-performance results while embracing sustainable practices in everything you do.


  

**We:**
* Strive to be the best; our mission is to become the world’s leading consulting company, empowering high\-performing individuals, regardless of gender or neurotype, to reach their full potential and leave a legacy of diversity, equality, inclusion, and excellence.
* Foster a culture of respect, value integrity, fairness, and the unique contributions of every team member.
* See mistakes as opportunities, embrace challenges, learn from them, and continuously improve.
* Prioritize potential over experience, believe intelligence, values, and growth matter more than the number of years on a résumé.

  

  

  

We believe in **potential, values, and growth**, so if this role excites you, let’s connect!  

**Your KVALITO Team.**

description:

**Location:** Work From Office – Surat, Gujarat

**Job Type:** Internship (6 Months) \+ Full\-Time Opportunity

**Experience Required:** Fresher / Recent Graduate

**Preferred Candidates:** Surat\-based applicants

**Who We Are**

**Logicwise Works** builds digital products that work for real users, at scale, with engineering quality that we take seriously. We are a small, high\-standards team operating in a competitive market where AI is reshaping what clients expect and what engineers must deliver.

We do not hire for headcount. We hire for people who want to grow fast, think independently, and build things that matter.

**The Honest Reality of This Role**

This internship is not a classroom. We will not walk you through every step. You will be given real problems, expected to think them through, and held to quality standards that reflect what clients actually need not just what training exercises require.

There will be pressure. There will be moments of uncertainty. That is intentional.

If you are looking for a structured, hand\-held learning experience, this is not the role. If you are looking for the fastest way to become a developer who can genuinely deliver, read on.

**What You Will Do**

* Own tasks end\-to\-end. Understand what you are building, why it exists, and who will use it before writing code
* Think before execution. Define goals, users, risks, and success criteria
* Test your work against real\-world expectations, not just functionality
* Use AI tools to improve productivity, debugging, and output quality
* Work on live project components with increasing independence
* Raise problems early and communicate what you have already tried
* Continuously improve your technical foundation

* You question assumptions, identify real constraints, and ensure your solution solves the actual problem.

C2: Curiosity

C3: Creative Thinking

**Non\-Negotiable**

* Genuine curiosity about how things work
* Ability to attempt problem\-solving independently before asking for help
* Self\-learning experience outside formal education (projects, tools, concepts)
* Active interest in AI and its impact on development
* Ability to accept and apply feedback constructively
* Strong foundation in programming logic, data structures, and problem\-solving

**Technical Foundation Expected**

* Programming: C / C\+\+ / Java / Python

**What This Role Will Give You**

* Real project exposure from day one
* A high\-standards work environment
* AI\-first workflow adoption
* Structured growth milestones
* Opportunity for a full\-time role based on performance
* Direct access to the founder and leadership

We are looking for a specific kind of person not the most experienced, but the most driven.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Company Description**

ProSca Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a business growth and transformation company dedicated to helping Indian MSMEs become globally competitive. Through our Export Growth Program (EGP), we work as implementation partners, helping companies transform their operations, systems, compliance frameworks, quality standards, and business processes to become export\-ready and successfully enter international markets. Unlike traditional consulting firms that only provide advice, ProSca works alongside businesses to execute, implement, monitor, and achieve measurable outcomes.

Our motto: "**Your growth, our goal."**

**Role Description**

We are looking for an energetic, ownership\-driven project manager who will take complete responsibility for the successful execution of client projects under our Export Growth Program. The project manager will lead the end\-to\-end transformation journey of MSMEs—from identifying gaps and implementing improvements to making companies export\-ready and supporting export execution. This role requires a leader who can build and manage teams, drive accountability, solve problems proactively, and ensure projects are completed successfully and on time. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in an early\-stage startup environment and wants to create meaningful impact while growing into a leadership role.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, engineering, commerce, operations management, industrial engineering, or a related field.
* An MBA or project management certification will be an added advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in project management, operations, quality management, manufacturing, business transformation, consulting, or related fields.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**End\-to\-End Project Ownership** 

* Take complete ownership of assigned client projects from onboarding to successful project completion.
* Develop and execute project plans, timelines, milestones, and transformation roadmaps.
* Ensure all project deliverables are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards.
* Identify risks, delays, and implementation challenges and take corrective actions proactively.
* Maintain project documentation, progress reports, trackers, and client records.

**Export Readiness \& Transformation Implementation** 

* Lead the implementation of initiatives required to make companies export\-ready.
* Coordinate and drive activities related to operational improvements, process development, documentation, compliance readiness, quality systems, and business transformation.
* Ensure clients successfully achieve export readiness milestones defined under the Export Growth Program.
* Support the execution of export\-related activities and international business development initiatives.
* Monitor implementation effectiveness and ensure measurable progress toward export goals.

**Quality Systems \& Compliance Implementation**

* Drive the implementation and strengthening of quality management systems and operational controls within client organisations.
* Coordinate activities related to standardisation, process documentation, SOP development, quality improvements, and compliance requirements.
* Ensure client organisations adopt sustainable systems that support long\-term growth and export competitiveness.
* Track implementation effectiveness and ensure improvements are embedded into day\-to\-day operations.
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Build, manage, and mentor project execution teams.
* Allocate responsibilities, track performance, and ensure accountability.
* Coordinate internal team members, subject matter experts, and support resources.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement, and results\-driven execution.
* Motivate and guide team members to achieve project objectives successfully.

**Client Relationship Management** 

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
* Conduct regular review meetings and progress discussions with business owners and leadership teams.
* Understand client challenges and drive solutions through effective execution.  Build long\-term relationships based on trust, transparency, and results.
* Ensure a high level of client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle.

**Process Development \& Organisational Scaling** 

* Develop and improve project management systems, execution frameworks, and operational processes.
* Create scalable systems that support the growth of both client projects and ProSca's internal operations.
* Contribute to building a world\-class execution\-driven organisation.

**Reporting \& Performance Monitoring** 

* Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports.
* Monitor project KPIs, milestones, budgets, and overall project health.
* Present progress updates, challenges, and recommendations to management.
* Drive projects toward measurable business outcomes and export success.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.
* Can build teams and get work done through people.
* Has strong leadership and execution capabilities.
* Enjoys solving complex business problems.
* Is excited about helping Indian MSMEs become export\-ready.
* Can balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Thrives in an early\-stage startup environment where adaptability is essential.
* Can motivate others while remaining self\-motivated.
* Is willing to grow with the company and take on increasing responsibilities.

**Compensation \& Growth Opportunities** 

**Probation Period** 

* 6\-Month Probation Period
* Fixed salary with performance review milestones

**Post Successful Probation** 

* Salary revision based on performance
* Eligibility for Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
* PF and other employee benefits
* Leadership development opportunities
* Opportunity to lead larger transformation programs and strategic initiatives
* Direct involvement in building a high\-growth company from the ground up

**Why Join ProSca? At ProSca,**

You will not merely manage projects—you will help transform businesses. You will work directly with MSME owners, implement real change inside organisations, help companies become export\-ready, and contribute to creating the next generation of successful Indian exporters. If you are ambitious, execution\-focused, and excited by the opportunity to build something meaningful, we would love to hear from you.

**Your Growth, Our Goal**.

title: Student Operations Executive
description:
**Soul Swara** is an online violin learning platform based in Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. We teach students across the world through structured live courses. We currently work with 85 students and are building systems to support the next stage of growth.

We're hiring a **Student Operations Executive** to own the backend of our student operations. You'll be the person who makes sure payments are tracked, schedules run on time, data stays clean, and nothing falls through the cracks.

**This is NOT a teaching, counseling, or sales role.** This is for someone who loves organised systems, clean data, and following up until things are done. You will need to follow up with students and parents for fees and pending items, but you are not expected to sell courses.

**What you'll own:**

* Student fee tracking — payment reminders, due dates, renewals, reconciliation with Razorpay
* Class schedule coordination — updates, reschedules, batch changes, teacher\-student mapping
* Student database management in Airtable — keeping records accurate and up to date
* Coordination between faculty, ops lead, and management on daily operational items
* Documentation — maintaining trackers, updating reports, flagging overdue items before they become problems
* Follow\-up discipline — chasing pending payments, incomplete onboarding steps, and missing documents without being told
* You'll work across 85\+ students today, so comfort with high\-volume, repeatable processes is important

**You're a great fit if:**

* You're naturally detail\-oriented — messy spreadsheets bother you
* You're comfortable with Google Sheets, Excel, or any database/tracker tool
* You can manage 50\+ follow\-up items without dropping any
* You've used AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, etc.) in your actual work — not just tried them once
* You take ownership of tasks and flag problems early rather than waiting to be asked
* You're comfortable communicating in English (written) and Tamil
* You're not shy about sending polite but firm reminders until something is closed

**Work structure:**

* Monday to Thursday: In\-office at Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai (10 AM – 5 PM)
* Friday: Remote
* 1\-month paid trial, then confirmation based on performance

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month, based on experience and trial performance

This role reports to our Head of Operations and is a core part of a small, fast\-moving team. If you're someone who finds satisfaction in a clean tracker and zero pending items at end of day, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):  
\* 

Have you worked with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets), Airtable, Tally, or any CRM/database tool to track data, payments, or schedules? Describe what you did in 2–3 sentences.

* You're managing a tracker of 85 students. You notice that 6 students show "payment due" but their class schedule is still active — meaning they're attending classes without having paid. What would you do, and in what order? Answer in 2–3 sentences.
* This role involves repeated follow\-up for pending payments, missing details, and schedule updates. Are you comfortable reminding people firmly but politely until the task is closed? Give an example if possible.
* Have you used ChatGPT or similar AI tools to complete real work, study, or documentation tasks? If so, explain what you used it for in 2–3 sentences.
* What is your current or most recent monthly take\-home salary, and what monthly salary are you expecting for this role? If fresher, write "Fresher" and mention your expected salary.

description:
**About Scale100X (by Expertrons)**
 Scale100X is a strategic growth platform designed to help high\-potential businesses scale rapidly through a proven franchise\-driven expansion model. Backed by Expertrons, it enables brands to expand aggressively while minimizing capital risk and operational complexity.
   

  

 Founded by IIT Bombay alumni Vivek Gupta and Jatin Solanki, Scale100X combines deep industry expertise with a strong execution track record. The company partners with businesses end\-to\-end—from franchise model design to marketing, recruitment, legal, and operational support—ensuring sustainable, long\-term growth.
   

  

 Job Title: Expansion Strategist Intern
   

  

**Job Brief**
 As an Expansion Strategist Intern, you will work directly with founders, business leaders, and the Scale100X core team to identify growth opportunities and develop expansion strategies for high\-potential businesses. You will gain hands\-on exposure to business consulting, franchise development, market research, and growth planning.
   

  

 This role is ideal for individuals passionate about startups, business strategy, entrepreneurship, and helping businesses scale through innovative expansion models.
   

  

 What does an Expansion Strategist do?
   

  

 An Expansion Strategist helps businesses identify growth opportunities, evaluate expansion potential, understand business models, and create scalable strategies that support sustainable growth through franchising and partnership networks.
   

  

 What does the Expansion Team do?
   

  

 The Expansion Team works closely with business founders to understand their products, services, and growth goals. The team analyzes business viability, identifies expansion opportunities, and supports founders in building scalable franchise and growth models.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Connect with founders to understand their vision, product offerings, and business goals.
* Analyze business models and identify opportunities for growth and expansion.
* Collaborate with founders to set up initial meetings for franchise expansion discussions.
* Provide strategic insights to improve business scalability.


 About Company: Expertrons is one of the world's largest AI video bot\-assisted platforms, focusing on providing a career transformation journey. Through this platform, we are connecting job\-seeking aspirants with Industry leaders, aka experts, helping them gain career insights, to settle their careers in their desired domains, from elite experts. **Job Title: System Administrator**

**About Us:**

MGL Group is a dynamic and growing organization. We are currently seeking a skilled and experienced System Administrator to join our IT team. This is an opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment where you can make a significant impact on our IT infrastructure.

**Job Summary:**

As a System Administrator, you will play a vital role in managing and maintaining our organization's IT systems and networks. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and optimal performance of our IT infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**System Maintenance:**

Install, configure, and maintain servers, workstations, and networking equipment.

Perform routine system updates and patch management.

Monitor system performance and respond to issues promptly.

**Network Administration:**

Administer and maintain the organization's local area network (LAN) and wide area network (WAN).

Configure and troubleshoot routers, switches, and firewalls.

Implement and maintain network security measures.

**User Support:**

Provide technical support to end\-users, addressing hardware and software issues.

Assist in the setup and configuration of workstations and peripherals.

**Data Backup and Recovery:**

Develop and maintain backup and recovery procedures to safeguard critical data.

Execute data backups and perform data restoration as needed.

**Security and Compliance:**

Implement and enforce security policies and practices to protect against cyber threats.

Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and industry standards.

**Documentation:**

Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date documentation of network configurations, hardware, and software inventory.

**Project Management:**

Plan, coordinate, and execute IT projects, such as system upgrades and migrations.

Collaborate with other IT professionals and departments to meet project goals.

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred).

* Proven experience as a System Administrator or in a similar role.
* Proficiency in Windows operating systems
* Familiarity with network protocols, security practices, and hardware.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
