title: Robotics Control Systems Engineer
description:
**About Rekise Marine** 




 Rekise Marine is building autonomous ships and submarines that operate in the world's most hostile environments. We're executing India's flagship autonomous submarine project — the Jalkapi XLAUV — on order from the Indian Navy. This is an unmanned submarine weighing over 20 tons that can travel 5,000\+ kilometers autonomously and operate in the ocean for 30\+ days at a time.
 



 We're creating some of the largest autonomous robots in the world, machines with direct impact on the global economy and national security. While autonomous cars in India may still be a dream, autonomous ships and submarines are already a reality, and it is possible to build for the world from India.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We're looking for a Robotics Engineer to design and implement the control systems that give our autonomous vessels precise, reliable movement through the ocean. You'll develop the algorithms that stabilize a 20\-ton vehicle at 300\-meter depths, manage thruster arrays, regulate buoyancy, and enable precise station\-keeping in unpredictable ocean currents. This role sits at the intersection of classical control theory and modern AI\-driven control, where your work directly determines whether the submarine can execute its mission safely and accurately.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Control System Design \& Implementation:** 
 Develop and implement robust control strategies including PID, adaptive control, Model Predictive Control (MPC), and Reinforcement Learning for underwater thrusters, buoyancy regulation, depth control, and attitude stabilization of a 20\-ton autonomous submarine.
* **Fault\-Tolerant Control:** 
 Design fault\-tolerant and adaptive control frameworks to handle thruster failures, sensor degradation, model uncertainties, and dynamic environmental disturbances (ocean currents, waves, hydrostatic pressure variations). Ensure graceful degradation under failure modes.
* **Sensor Integration \& Feedback:** 
 Integrate control algorithms with sensor feedback from DVL, INS, depth sensors, pressure transducers, and IMUs for precise real\-time performance. Design observer and estimator systems for states that cannot be directly measured.
* **Validation \& Testing:** 
 Conduct comprehensive hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and simulation\-based validation before deployment. Develop systematic testing protocols, performance benchmarks, and safety verification procedures for control systems.
* **Autonomy Stack Integration:** 
 Collaborate with planning, navigation, perception, and communications teams to ensure seamless integration of control systems within the full autonomy stack. Define control interfaces and handoff protocols between mission planning and vehicle execution layers.
* **System Identification \& Modeling:** 
 Perform system identification experiments and develop accurate dynamic models of the submarine platform including hydrodynamic coefficients, thruster dynamics, and environmental interaction models.



  





  





**Required Qualifications** 



* B.Tech/M.S./Ph.D. in Robotics, Control Systems, Ocean Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field from a recognized institution.
* 2\+ years of experience in control design and implementation for autonomous systems (AUV, UAV, AGV, or similar).
* Strong foundation in classical and modern control theory including nonlinear control, Lyapunov stability analysis, and observer design.
* Proficiency in
 **C\+\+** 
 with real\-time software development experience.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **ROS2** 
 and control middleware for autonomous platforms.
* Experience with MPC solvers, optimization libraries (CasADi, ACADOS, OSQP), and control\-tuned RL frameworks.
* Knowledge of system identification techniques and dynamic modeling.
* Strong mathematical foundations in differential equations, linear algebra, and optimization.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Publications in top\-tier robotics/control conferences/journals (ICRA, IROS, CDC, ACC, ICAR).
* Hands\-on experience with real\-world Autonomous Systems (AGV/AUV/UAV/ASV), field trials, and deployments.
* Knowledge of hydrodynamics modeling, added mass effects, and marine vehicle dynamics.
* Background in embedded control implementation (real\-time OS, FPGA, or microcontrollers).
* Experience with formal verification or safety\-critical control system certification.
* Familiarity with thruster allocation and redundancy management for multi\-actuator systems.
* Experience with learning\-based control (model\-based RL, adaptive neural control).



  





  





  





  





**Why Join Rekise Marine** 



* **Control the Depths:** 
 Design control systems for one of the world's largest autonomous underwater vehicles. The challenges — stabilizing a 20\-ton platform at 300m depth in ocean currents — are unmatched in India.
* **Mission Impact:** 
 Your control algorithms directly determine whether the submarine completes its mission safely. Every controller you tune, every fault mode you handle, strengthens India's defense capabilities.
* **Technical Ownership:** 
 You'll architect the control systems from the ground up. Your design philosophy will define how our submarines move through the ocean for years to come.
* **Growth:** 
 As we scale from prototype to fleet, your role grows from control engineer to control systems architect.
* **Benefits:** 
 Competitive compensation and Health insurance for you and your family

description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Psychologist
description:
**Background**  

The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance the quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the health and well\-being of remote and under\-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities, and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two\-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North\-East, and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower\-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.  

Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through the direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not\-for\-profit organizations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.  

  

**GENERAL****Project:** Hans Child Development Centre**Location of Job:** Hyderabad**Type of Employment:** Full time**No. of Position:** 1**Reporting to: Project Manager** **1\.JOB PURPOSE**
Hans Child Development Centre provides multidisciplinary services to children with special needs, including Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Speech \& Language Impairment, Locomotor Disabilities, Down Syndrome, ADHD, and other developmental disabilities.
The **Behavior Modification Therapist (Psychologist)** will be responsible for assessing, designing, and implementing individualized behavior intervention plans to address challenging behaviors, enhance social skills, and promote positive coping strategies in children. This role involves close collaboration with a multidisciplinary team and active engagement with parents to ensure consistent support across therapy and home environments. **KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES*** Conduct comprehensive behavioral and psychological assessments to identify triggers, strengths, and areas of need.
* Develop and implement individualized Behavior Intervention Planstailored to each child’s developmental profile.
* Use evidence\-based techniques (e.g., Applied Behavior Analysis, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Social Skills Training) to reduce maladaptive behaviors and reinforce positive behaviors.
* Conduct one\-on\-one and group therapy sessions focusing on emotional regulation, attention, communication, and social interaction.
* Monitor progress, maintain accurate documentation, and modify strategies as required.
* Educate and train parents/caregivers on behavior management strategies for use at home.
* Collaborate with special educators, speech therapists, occupational therapists, and physiotherapists to ensure integrated care.
* Conduct workshops or training sessions for staff and parents on behavior management techniques.
* Maintain confidentiality and uphold ethical standards in all interactions.

 **Other Indicative Requirements** **Educational Qualifications**
Master’s Degree in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, or Counseling Psychology from a recognized institution. **Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience \& Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)**  

Minimum 1\-2 years of experience in behavior therapy or child psychology, preferably in pediatric or special needs settings (freshers with strong skills may also be considered).  

Knowledge of ABA, CBT, play therapy, and other behavioral modification strategies. **Skills \& Competencies:*** Strong observation, documentation, and analytical skills.
* Empathy, patience, and a child\-friendly approach.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to work with children, families, and colleagues.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
* Strong ethics and sensitivity towards the needs of children with disabilities.

We do not discriminate in employment on the basis of caste, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other such matter.**

title: HR recruiter
description:
**HR Recruiter job description**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and results\-driven Recruiter to join our Human Resources team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and on boarding top talent to support business goals. You will play a critical role in driving our hiring strategies and ensuring a seamless recruitment process.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment:**

* **Job Postings and Descriptions:** Creating and publishing job descriptions on various platforms to attract qualified candidates.
* **Screening and Shortlisting:** Reviewing resumes, conducting initial interviews, and narrowing down candidates based on role requirements.
* **Interview Coordination:** Scheduling and organizing interviews with hiring managers, panels, or leadership.
* **Offer Negotiation and Issuance:**
* Drafting, reviewing, and issuing offer letters and employment contracts.
* Communicating compensation, benefits, and other job details with selected candidates.

**2\. Onboarding and Induction:**

* Coordinating pre\-joining formalities like document collection, background verification.
* Organizing new hire orientations to familiarize employees with company policies and culture.

**3\. Maintaining Employee Data:**

* **HRIS Management:**
* Recording and updating employee information, such as personal details, joining details, and role changes.
* Tracking probation, confirmations, and contract renewals.
* Maintaining documentation for compliance purposes, such as employment contracts, offer letters, and verification documents.

**4\. Exit Formalities:**

* **Resignation Handling:** Accepting resignation letters and initiating the offboarding process.
* **Clearance Process:** Coordinating with various departments for no\-dues clearance.
* **Exit Interviews:** Conducting interviews to gather feedback and improve the recruitment process.
* **Document Issuance:** Preparing and issuing relieving letters, experience certificates.

**5\. Compliance and Reporting:**

* Ensuring adherence to labor laws and organizational policies during recruitment and offboarding.
* Generating recruitment and attrition reports to analyze trends and improve processes.

**6\. Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Collaborating with hiring managers to understand job requirements and talent expectations.
* Acting as a liaison between employees, leadership, and external recruitment agencies when required.

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* Proven experience in recruitment.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing techniques, recruitment tools, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
description:
**About the Role**

We’re seeking a mid\-level FP\&A Manager to own budgeting, forecasting, and performance insights that drive decision\-making across the business. You’ll partner closely with leadership and cross\-functional teams to translate financial data into clear, actionable recommendations.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Budgeting and Forecasting**: Lead the annual planning cycle and maintain rolling forecasts for revenue, opex/capex, and cash flow; identify risks and opportunities early and propose course corrections.
* **Variance Analysis**: Compare plan vs. actuals, explain performance drivers with clarity, and recommend corrective or acceleration actions.
* **Financial Modeling**: Build robust, scenario\-based models for pricing, new products/facilities, investments, and market/economic shifts; test sensitivities and communicate implications.
* **Management Reporting and Storytelling**: Craft concise, insight\-led dashboards and presentations for CEOs, CFOs, and functional leaders to support strategic and operational decisions.
* **Business Partnering**: Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Operations to connect operational drivers to financial outcomes and improve forecast accuracy.
* **Process and Controls**: Improve planning/reporting processes, standardize templates, and enhance data quality and timeliness.

**Key Skills and Experience**

* **Advanced Data Proficiency**: Expert Excel skills (modelling, Power Query/Power Pivot preferred) and strong data visualization experience (e.g., Power BI).
* **Enterprise Tools**: Hands\-on experience with enterprise performance management/planning platforms (e.g., SAP EPM/BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar).
* **Financial Acumen**: Solid grasp of P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow dynamics; ability to connect commercial and operational KPIs to financial results.
* **Communication**: Clear, structured communicator who can translate complex analyses into executive\-ready narratives and visuals.
* **Collaboration**: Track record of partnering across functions to drive accountability and outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field; MBA/FCA/CMA is a plus.
* 4–7 years of relevant FP\&A or corporate finance experience in a mid\-to\-large or fast\-growing organization.
* Demonstrated experience owning budgeting/forecasting cycles and building scenario models.
* Comfortable working with large datasets; SQL exposure is a plus.

**Success Measures (Within 6–12 Months)**

* Increased forecast accuracy and on\-time monthly reporting.
* Clear driver\-based models in place for revenue, margin, and cash flow.
* Executable insights presented to leadership with measurable impact on decisions.
* Streamlined planning processes and standardized reporting.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance bonus.

Area Head – Gold Loans is responsible for driving strategy execution, growth, profitability, portfolio quality and operational governance across the assigned area. The role ensures achievement of AUM, disbursement, P\&L, branch expansion and compliance targets through leadership of teams. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.* **New Relationship**

==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organization Context**
Aditya Birla Capital Limited ("NBFC") is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABCL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Sep’25, ABCL has a pan\-India presence with a lending book of approx. Rs. 139,500 Crores.  

ABCL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABCL also has a Wealth Management division.  

ABCL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABCL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII. **Business Context** **Job Context:**  

Translate regional gold loan strategy into area execution plan while balancing rapid growth with strict risk discipline. This position execution of business initiatives, overseeing profit and loss statements, ensuring adherence to risk management and regulatory compliance, and leading teams to meet established targets. **Key Challenges:*** Driving rapid AUM growth while maintaining strict LTV norms, low NPAs and strong collateral cover amid gold price volatility.
* Ensuring zero deviation compliance with RBO guidelines across a large, distributed branch network without slowing business momentum.
* Preventing fraud, jewelry substitution, internal collusion and security breaches while scaling operations
* Improving performance of underproductive branches and optimizing fixed costs in a high volume, low ticker business.
* Protecting branch reputation by delivering transparent, fast and respectful customer experiences for a highly emotional asset.

description:
**Job Summary**

The HR Executive is responsible for handling various HR functions including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, payroll support, and compliance. The role ensures that HR policies are effectively implemented and that employees have a positive work environment.

**Key Responsibilities:** 

**1\. Recruitment \& Staffing**

* Assist in sourcing candidates through job portals, social media, and referrals
* Screen resumes and schedule interviews
* Coordinate interview processes and follow\-ups
* Support hiring and selection procedures

**2\. Onboarding \& Induction**

* Manage employee onboarding and orientation programs
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and joining documentation
* Ensure smooth integration of new hires

**3\. Employee Relations**

* Address employee queries and concerns
* Maintain positive workplace culture
* Assist in resolving conflicts and disciplinary issues

**4\. HR Operations**

* Maintain employee records and HR databases
* Handle attendance, leave management, and documentation
* Support performance management processes

**5\. Payroll \& Compensation Support**

* Assist in payroll preparation and processing
* Maintain salary records and benefits administration

title: Special Education Teacher
company: prayaas therapy and child development center
description:
1\. Special Educator (Special Education Teacher)

Purpose of Role: To provide tailored academic and developmental support to students with diverse learning needs, ensuring they meet their educational potential through individualized instruction.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a dedicated Special Educator to join our team. You will be responsible for assessing student needs, developing Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), and adapting the general curriculum to accommodate various learning disabilities (including Autism, ADHD, Dyslexia, and other developmental delays). You will work closely with parents, general education teachers, and therapists to create a supportive learning environment.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Assessment \& Planning: Assess students’ skills to determine their needs and develop Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) with specific, measurable goals.

\* Instruction: Plan, organize, and assign activities that are specific to each student’s abilities; teach socially acceptable behavior and daily living skills.

\* Curriculum Adaptation: Modify the general education curriculum for special\-needs students based upon a variety of instructional techniques and technologies.

\* Collaboration: Meet with parents, counselors, and administrators to discuss student progress; co\-teach with regular education teachers to support inclusion.

\* Documentation: Maintain accurate and complete student records, progress reports, and compliance with all state/federal regulations.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Special Education.

\* Valid State/National Special Education Teaching License/Certification.

\* Experience working with children/adults with special needs (specific diagnosis experience can be specified here, e.g., ASD).

\* Knowledge of IEP development and special education laws (e.g., IDEA).

2\. Speech Therapist (Speech\-Language Pathologist)

Purpose of Role: To diagnose and treat individuals with speech, language, voice, fluency, and swallowing disorders, helping them communicate effectively.

Job Summary:

We are hiring a compassionate and skilled Speech\-Language Pathologist (SLP). You will evaluate and treat clients with communication disorders, ranging from articulation and fluency issues to complex language processing disorders. You will work within a multidisciplinary team to help clients achieve functional communication goals.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Conduct comprehensive screenings and assessments to identify speech, language, and swallowing disorders.

\* Treatment Planning: Create and implement individualized treatment plans tailored to the specific needs of the client (e.g., articulation therapy, language intervention, dysphagia management).

\* Therapy Delivery: Provide individual or group therapy sessions using evidence\-based techniques and therapeutic tools (including AAC devices where necessary).

\* Family Education: Counsel and train family members and caregivers on how to support the client’s communication development at home.

\* Collaboration: Consult with teachers, special educators, and other therapists to integrate speech goals into the client's daily routine.

Qualifications:

\* Master’s degree in Speech\-Language Pathology.

\* Valid State License and ASHA Certification (CCC\-SLP) or equivalent national certification.

\* Experience with pediatric or adult populations (depending on your facility's focus).

\* Proficiency in using Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices is a plus.

3\. Occupational Therapist (OT)

Purpose of Role: To help individuals develop, recover, and improve the skills needed for daily living and working, focusing on physical, sensory, and cognitive independence.

Job Summary:

We are looking for an Occupational Therapist to help our clients participate fully in their daily lives. You will work with individuals who have conditions that are mentally, physically, developmentally, or emotionally disabling. Your focus will be on "occupations" of daily life—from self\-care (dressing, eating) to school performance (handwriting, focus) and play.

Key Responsibilities:

\* Evaluation: Assess clients’ physical, sensory, and cognitive abilities to determine their functional levels and barriers to independence.

\* Intervention: Develop therapeutic programs to improve fine motor skills, sensory processing, hand\-eye coordination, and daily living skills (ADLs).

\* Sensory Integration: Design and implement sensory diets and environmental modifications to help clients regulate their sensory systems.

\* Equipment Recommendation: Advise on and teach the use of adaptive equipment (e.g., pencil grips, wheelchairs, sensory aids) to replace lost function.

\* Documentation \& Review: Regularly evaluate progress, modifying treatment plans as necessary, and maintain precise clinical documentation.

Qualifications:

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy.

\* Valid State License and National Board Certification (NBCOT).

\* Strong background in Sensory Integration (SI) therapy is often highly valued.

\* Ability to lift and move clients/equipment as needed.

Quick Comparison for Hiring Managers

If you are hiring for a center, it is helpful to know the distinct "lane" for each professional to avoid role confusion:

\| Role \| Primary Focus \| Key Outcome \|

\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|\-\-\-\|

\| Special Educator \| Academics \& Behavior \| The student can access the curriculum and learn in a classroom setting. \|

\| Speech Therapist \| Communication \& Swallowing \| The client can speak, understand language, and express needs clearly. \|

\| Occupational Therapist \| Daily Function \& Motor Skills \| The client can independently perform tasks like writing, dressing, and playing. \|

Miracles is a technology\-driven proprietary trading and research firm building scalable, high\-performance quantitative trading systems. We operate across Indian financial markets including NSE, BSE, and MCX, with a strong emphasis on data\-driven research, innovation, and systematic trading.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Quantitative Researcher (Fresher)** to join our growing research team. This role is ideal for graduates with strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, and programming who are eager to apply their analytical skills to real\-world financial markets.

* Full strategy lifecycle: idea → backtest → validation → live deployment

title: Sr. Manager Taxation
description:
**Job title: Sr. Manager Taxation**  

**Location: Mumbai**

**About the job**

**Our Team:**


Sanofi India is seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Manager – Taxation to lead and manage the company's end\-to\-end tax function across direct tax, indirect tax, and transfer pricing. The role is pivotal in ensuring full statutory compliance while driving proactive tax planning and advisory to support Sanofi's business objectives in India. The incumbent will serve as a key finance business partner, working closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors to manage tax risks and optimize the company's tax position. This is a leadership role that requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and strong stakeholder management skills within a fast\-paced multinational pharmaceutical environment.

**Main responsibilities:**


 1\. Direct Tax


Manage corporate income tax computations, advance tax workings, and ensure timely payment of taxes  

Oversee TDS/TCS compliance including monthly payments, quarterly return filings (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q), and issuance of certificates  

Prepare and file annual income tax returns and related forms (e.g., Form 3CEB, 3CD, 29B)  

Lead tax assessments and manage scrutiny proceedings before Assessing Officers, CIT(A), and ITAT  

Monitor and manage tax litigation portfolio; coordinate with external counsel for appeals and hearings  

Track legislative changes and assess their impact on the company's tax position  

2\. Indirect Tax (GST)


Oversee end\-to\-end GST compliance including preparation and filing of GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9, and GSTR\-9C  

Manage GST audits, departmental inquiries, and notices; coordinate responses with external advisors  

Drive GST refund claims (export refunds, inverted duty structure) and follow up for timely processing  

Provide advisory on GST implications for new business initiatives, contracts, and supply chain arrangements  

Ensure accurate input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation and compliance with anti\-profiteering provisions  

3\. Transfer Pricing


Prepare and maintain comprehensive Transfer Pricing (TP) documentation including Master File, Local File, and Country\-by\-Country Reporting (CbCR)  

Conduct benchmarking analysis and ensure arm's length pricing for all intercompany transactions  

Manage TP audits and assessments; liaise with external TP advisors and tax authorities  

Review intercompany agreements and ensure alignment with TP policies and OECD guidelines  

Monitor changes in Indian TP regulations and BEPS developments and assess business impact  

4\. Tax Planning \& Advisory


Identify and implement tax optimization opportunities in compliance with applicable laws  

Provide tax advisory on business transactions, new product launches, contracts, and commercial arrangements  

Support M\&A, restructuring, and integration activities from a tax due diligence and structuring perspective  

Advise on withholding tax implications for cross\-border payments and treaty benefits  

Collaborate with the global tax team on international tax matters impacting India operations  

5\. Regulatory \& Statutory Compliance


Liaise with income tax authorities, GST authorities, and other regulatory bodies  

Manage and respond to tax notices, show cause notices, and information requests in a timely manner  

Represent the company at hearings before tax authorities and appellate forums  

Maintain a comprehensive tracker of all ongoing litigation, notices, and compliance deadlines  

Ensure compliance with FEMA, RBI regulations, and other applicable statutes as relevant to the tax function  

6\. Financial Reporting \& Tax Accounting


Support preparation of current and deferred tax provisions under Ind AS 12 / IAS 12  

Ensure accurate tax disclosures in standalone and consolidated financial statements  

Coordinate with statutory auditors and internal auditors on tax\-related matters  

Maintain tax balance sheet reconciliations and support quarterly/annual closing processes  

Provide tax inputs for budgeting, forecasting, and effective tax rate (ETR) analysis  

7\. Stakeholder Management


Partner with Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, Commercial, and HR teams to provide proactive tax guidance  

Manage relationships with external tax advisors, Big 4 firms, and legal counsel  

Coordinate with the global/regional tax team on cross\-border matters and group reporting requirements  

Present tax updates, risk assessments, and planning opportunities to senior leadership  

8\. Team Leadership


Lead, mentor, and develop junior tax professionals within the team  

Foster a culture of continuous learning, compliance excellence, and accountability  

Delegate responsibilities effectively and ensure quality review of all tax deliverables  

Build team capability through training on evolving tax laws and best practices

**About you**

**Education**


Chartered Accountant (CA) – mandatory

**Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant tax experience
* Industry Preference
* Multinational corporation or Big 4 public accounting firm; pharma/life sciences sector is a plus

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong command of Indian direct tax laws, GST, transfer pricing regulations, and Ind AS / IFRS Systems
* Proficiency in SAP or similar ERP systems; working knowledge of tax compliance tools

**Additional Qualification**


LLB or postgraduate degree in taxation is an added advantage

**Key Competencies**


Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills – Ability to interpret complex tax laws and translate them into practical business solutions  

Communication \& Stakeholder Management – Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to present tax matters clearly to non\-tax audiences  

Prioritization \& Agility – Capable of managing multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment  

Integrity \& Attention to Detail – High standards of professional ethics with meticulous attention to accuracy and compliance  

Strategic Thinking with Hands\-On Execution – Ability to think at a strategic level while remaining engaged in operational details  

Collaborative Leadership – Team player who leads by example and builds strong cross\-functional relationships


Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary


Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.


At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.


Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

Candidates should be comfortable using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) in their day\-to\-day workflows, able to evaluate AI\-generated outputs critically, and open to continuously adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge.

  

**Overview:**



Lead Precisely's global corporate travel program, ensuring a seamless and policy\-compliant travel experience for employees worldwide. You will manage a Travel Administrator based in India and personally support global employees with their travel needs alongside your team. This role combines hands\-on employee support with program leadership, overseeing Concur and Coupa platforms, T\&E card program, supplier relationships, and travel policy. You will partner with Finance, HR, and leadership to drive cost savings, duty\-of\-care compliance, and continuous improvement across the travel function and employee experience.


**What you will do:**


* Own and manage the global corporate travel program, including policy governance and direct support for employees worldwide
* Administer and optimize the Concur travel system and Coupa expense platform for maximum adoption and compliance
* Manage the corporate T\&E card program, including card issuance, tracking, and reconciliation
* Own the strategic relationship with Frosch (Travel Management Company), including conducting regular QBRs, holding them accountable to SLAs, and driving continuous service improvement
* Negotiate and ensure competitive rates and best practices with Frosch and other travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, car rental agencies)
* Lead Travel RFP processes including scoping requirements, managing vendor responses, evaluating proposals, and driving selection decisions
* Maintain high\-quality travel service standards for employees globally, resolving escalations and ensuring a positive traveler experience
* Serve as a direct point of support for global employees on travel bookings, queries, and escalations alongside the travel admin
* Analyze travel spend data, expense reports, and KPIs to identify savings opportunities and policy improvement areas
* Ensure duty\-of\-care obligations are met, including traveler tracking and emergency protocols
* Partner with Finance on expense reporting, budgeting, and audit support
* Develop and communicate travel policy updates to employees globally


**What we are looking for:**


**Required:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or related field (equivalent work experience accepted)
* Minimum 8 years of corporate travel management experience, including direct employee\-facing support
* Atleast 2 years in a supervisory or team lead role
* Experience with a corporate travel management platform (Concur or similar)
* Experience managing a T\&E card program


**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience managing a TMC relationship (Frosch, BCD, Amex GBT, or similar)
* Experience running a Travel RFP process
* Experience coordinating travel for large\-scale corporate events
* Knowledge of travel risk management and duty\-of\-care frameworks


**AI Skills/Knowledge:**


* Use AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot to analyze travel spend patterns, generate exception reports, and identify policy breaches
* Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated insights and apply findings to program improvements

**About the Role** 




 As an HR Coordinator, your primary contribution will be to shape how candidates experience CynLr from the moment they discover an opportunity to the moment they join. You will support hiring teams in carrying the organization’s impression in an insightful, consistent, and high\-context manner. This role combines recruitment coordination, employer branding, stakeholder communication, process discipline, and early\-stage organizational alignment.
 



**What You Will Do** 




 • Applicant stage: Adapt job descriptions to the requirements and audience of each platform, including LinkedIn, the company website, and other relevant channels, to improve discoverability and attractiveness. Research candidate demographics, skill combinations, and platform behavior to determine where and when to publish roles for maximum relevance.
 



 • Campus recruitment: Support high\-coordination campus hiring efforts where the objective is not volume but identifying the right candidate in a difficult market. Help manage large applicant pools, communication flows, institution coordination, and branding touchpoints across campuses.
 



 • Candidate stage: Send and coordinate emails for tests and interviews, share preparation details, ensure support team availability, maintain test records and reports, and contribute to the design of filtering criteria using available assessment data.
 



 • Selected candidate stage: Manage candidate confirmations, coordinate interview logistics with relevant stakeholders, maintain interview performance records, and ensure timely follow\-up communication for all candidates who participate in the process.
 



 • Onboarding stage: Log new joiner details into internal systems, generate employee IDs, coordinate with IT for asset issuance, collect required documents, and administer internal and statutory induction programs.
 



 • Employer impression and communication: Act as a consistent and professional point of contact for candidates, helping remove communication roadblocks and ensuring that the organization’s values, expectations, and founder’s impression are carried meaningfully throughout the journey.
 



**Job Requirements** 




 • Domain and tool knowledge: Understanding of business operations, communication fundamentals, HR operations, employer branding, and negotiation. Familiarity with major job portals, applicant tracking systems, payroll software, and strong working knowledge of MS Office tools.
 



 • Core skills: Strong organization, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to interface effectively with external stakeholders. Excellent professional communication and negotiation skills, an understanding of human psychology, and the ability to manage expectations with maturity and clarity.
 



 • Behavioral tendencies: Critical thinking, responsibility, versatility, resourcefulness, availability, thoroughness, and strong attention to detail.
 



**What Success Looks Like** 




 • Roles are clearly defined, market\-informed, and aligned with the company’s stage and business needs.
 



 • Hiring processes are structured, candidate\-centric, and continuously improving through data and feedback.
 



 • Strong talent pipelines are built across experienced hiring, campus hiring, and institutional partnerships.
 



 • Employer messaging resonates with the right candidates across different talent segments and platforms.
 



 • Cross\-functional hiring teams are supported with clarity, responsiveness, and strategic insight.
 



**Who We Are Looking For** 




 • You are deeply curious and prefer understanding the problem before applying templates or assumptions.
 



 • You are action\-oriented and enjoy building, coordinating, and improving systems rather than only advising on them.
 



 • You think analytically and can connect business context, talent strategy, and market behavior.
 



 • You communicate clearly and can work effectively across founders, hiring managers, HR teams, branding teams, and operations stakeholders.
 



 • You are excited by startup environments where roles evolve quickly and thoughtful hiring can create outsized impact.
 



**Who You Will Work With** 




 You will work closely with the HR and Talent Management team for execution. You will also collaborate extensively with Branding and Tech teams to shape role narratives and hiring journeys, and partner with Operations and Finance teams where planning and budget considerations are involved.
 



**How Your Career Progresses** 




 We see this role as the starting point of a long\-term journey into Human Resources Management at CynLr. In a startup environment, the company evolves quickly and the needs of the organization expand continuously. Over time, this role can open pathways into specialized areas within HR, including talent acquisition, people operations, employer branding, onboarding, and broader organizational development.
 



**Why Join Us** 




 If you are excited by the idea of building hiring systems that are strategic, analytical, and deeply human, this role offers the chance to shape how a company discovers and develops talent from the ground up. You will help define not just who we hire, but how we think about roles, talent markets, candidate journeys, and long\-term organizational growth.

**Graduate Engineer Trainee – Supply Chain \& Operations Communications (IIT Graduates Preferred)**  
**Location: Civil Area / Site\-Based Experience: Fresher (Class of 2025 / 2026\)Industry: Infrastructure / Infratech / Manufacturing About Us**

We are not just a software company; we are an infrastructure company whose moat is cutting\-edge workflow technology. We are solving the single biggest bottleneck in the Indian EPC and construction sector: **Material Readiness**.

Every massive infrastructure project is governed by the "Iron Triangle" of **Schedule, Cost, and Quality**, which relies heavily on the 3 Ms: *Material, Manpower, and Machinery*. We own the Material readiness vertical, transforming chaotic site requests into a clean, visible, and bulletproof workflow.

We are looking for sharp, analytical, and highly articulate minds from India's premier institutes (IITs) to bridge the gap between heavy engineering operations and tech\-driven supply chain management.

**The Role: What You Will Do**

As a GET in Supply Chain \& Operations Communications, you won't just sit behind a desk. You will be at the heartbeat of execution, ensuring that the "Site as a Unit" achieves 100% workflow coverage. You will act as the vital communication and operational link between site engineers, stores, and project directors.

* **Drive Site Adoption \& Coverage:** Work directly on\-site to transition stakeholders (Site\-in\-Charge, Project Directors, Store\-in\-Charge, and Field Engineers) from traditional chaos to our structured workflow platform.
* **Operational Communication:** Bridge the communication gap between site reality and downstream procurement. Ensure daily material indents and requests are moving flawlessly from request to receipt.
* **Data\-Driven Supply Chain Management:** Track metrics for high\-value projects (\~₹100 Cr\+ project turnover). Monitor and clear bottlenecks for thousands of active indents.
* **Feedback Loop Creation:** Act as the eyes and ears on the ground. Translate the practical difficulties of users working in the dust and on the move into actionable insights for our Design and Engineering teams.

**What Constitutes a "Win" in This Role?**

* **Not a Win:** A few isolated sign\-ups or getting a couple of engineers to use a tool.
* **A Real Win:** Managing a fully covered, live site where all key stakeholders are actively driving 100% of their material demand through the system.

**Who We Are Looking For (Qualifications)**

* **Education:** B.Tech / Dual Degree from a premier Indian Institute of Technology (**IIT preferred**). Open to all engineering branches (Civil, Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering is a heavy plus).
* **Experience:** **Fresher**. We want raw problem\-solving capability, high energy, and a clean slate.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be equally comfortable presenting data to a corporate Project Director as you are explaining a workflow to a ground\-level Store\-in\-Charge.
* **Grit \& Mindset:** You believe that "Infra leads and Tech serves". You are willing to work in civil environments/construction sites where the real action happens, prioritizing substance over flashy corporate labels.

**Why Join Us?**

* **High Impact:** You will directly influence the efficiency of ₹100 Crore\+ infrastructure projects.
* **Unmatched Exposure:** You will gain a deep, 360\-degree understanding of supply chain logistics, procurement, and tech deployment in heavy industries.
* **Accelerated Growth:** Working at the intersection of a massive traditional industry and proprietary software gives you a career trajectory that typical corporate IT or traditional manufacturing roles cannot match.

**To Apply:** Please submit your resume highlighting any supply chain, operations, or leadership experience during your time at IIT.

Bedrock Foundry is a technology\-driven company building scalable and reliable software systems. We focus on high\-performance engineering, clean architecture, and modern development practices.

We are hiring an Embedded Engineer to join our engineering team in Kozhikode. This is a full\-time, onsite role tailored for freshers or junior engineers with 0 to 2 years of experience who want to build firmware and explore high\-performance hardware systems.

* Actively participate in automation efforts using tools like Ansible, Terraform, or scripts to reduce manual operational work
* Monitor system health and performance, and participate in routine optimisation tasks
* Contribute to implementing and maintaining data backup and disaster recovery processes
* Collaborate actively with senior engineers and internal teams to understand infrastructure and hosting requirements
* Assist in diagnosing and resolving production issues under guidance, ensuring service stability
* Maintain and update technical documentation related to systems, processes, and runbooks


**Who you are:**
* Between 1\-3 years of professional experience
* Solid fundamentals in Linux and basic system administration
* Exposure to at least one data storage system (SQL, NoSQL, RDBMS, or distributed storage), such as
* PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, ScyllaDB, MinIO, etc
* Basic understanding of data backup concepts and disaster recovery principles
* Familiarity with automation or scripting tools such as Ansible, Bash, or Terraform (hands\-on experience is a plus, not mandatory)
* Strong willingness to learn, ask questions, and grow in a distributed systems and infrastructure environment
* Good troubleshooting mindset with the ability to analyse issues and learn from incidents
* Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Exposure to cloud platforms or containerised environments
* Academic or personal projects involving databases, automation, or infrastructure
* Interest in scalability, reliability, and platform engineering best practices


**Why people love working at Brevo:**
* A place to grow, together: Join a diverse, international team in a modern office buzzing with energy and ideas
* Practical perks for everyday balance: Cab Facility and per\-day meal vouchers; Employee\-friendly salary structure; 1\.4x pay on holidays/weekends for critical work; excellent referral program with high\-value gift options (e.g., bike, flight tickets)
* Learning, every step of the way: Over 1,55,000 courses on Udemy, along with facilitator\-led sessions, and personalised training programs tailored to individual and team needs
* Flexible for life: A hybrid setup (2 days WFH), budget for your home workspace, and a generous leave policy to help you balance life and work effortlessly
* Wellbeing that works: INR 10 Lakh medical insurance, maternity support, childcare facilities, and wellness bonuses to keep you and your family covered
* A culture that cares: Annual company off\-sites, inter\-office trips, team outings, active social, green, and LGBTQIA\+ communities, along with festive celebrations \- all making Brevo a vibrant and inclusive workplace


**Our candidate journey:**
* Round 1 \- Screening call with the Talent Acquisition team
* Round 2 \- Face\-to\-Face Interview with our Deputy Platform Manager
* Round 3 \- Virtual Interview with the Hiring Manager
* Round 4 \- Virtual Interview with the VP of Platform


 Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

**About Drone Nuggets:** Drone Nuggets is an aerial education and experiences company on a mission to unlock the sky for everyone. Our hands\-on programs help children and beginners explore aviation, electronics, aerodynamics, RC flight, and drone technology through build kits, guided learning, and live workshops.

**Role Overview:**

Drone Nuggets is looking for instructors who can make learning feel exciting, practical, and memorable. This is not a typical classroom teaching role. It is a hands\-on, high\-energy teaching opportunity for people who enjoy working with young learners, love explaining how things work, and want to grow in a modern learning environment.

This role begins on a contractual basis, but it is designed for people who want to build a longer journey with us. Over time, strong instructors can take on more responsibility across workshop delivery, student experience, curriculum input, and program development.

**Location:** Workshops are currently conducted in Indiranagar, Koramangala, Sarjapur, Cooke Town, and Whitefield. You will primarily be assigned to two of these locations, which can be discussed during the interview.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct hands\-on STEM and drone learning sessions for students.
* Teach concepts such as aerodynamics, basic electronics, drones, and aeromodelling in a clear and engaging way.
* Support students during build activities, experiments, and workshop exercises.
* Help set up, manage, and run sessions smoothly and safely.
* Work closely with the team to improve workshop delivery and student experience.

* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to simplify and explain concepts clearly

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior teaching, training, or workshop experience
* Interest in drones, aeromodelling, or hands\-on STEM activities
* Ability to manage groups of students effectively
* Basic troubleshooting skills for simple hardware setups

You do **not** need a degree for this role. What matters most is: A genuine passion for teaching, and a strong thirst for learning.

**Why Join Drone Nuggets:**

* Work in a growing aerospace and STEM education environment with real room for long\-term growth.
* Get hands\-on exposure to practical STEM applications through drones, aeromodelling, electronics, and live workshop delivery.
* Be part of a flexible, project\-based teaching structure that is active, modern, and high\-energy.
* Join a collaborative, learning\-focused team where you can grow into larger responsibilities over time.

Day\-to\-day responsibilities include front\-end development, back\-end development, and contributing to seamless end\-to\-end software development processes. The role also includes collaborating with team members to troubleshoot and optimize solutions to improve business efficiency for our clients.

description:
**Job Title:** e\-Commerce Executive / Amazon Account Executive \[Online Sales]  
**Location:** Corporate Park, Sector 142, Noida \[Less than 1 Minute walk from 142 Metro Station]  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \[Remote not Allowed]  
**Min Experience:** 1\-3 Years \[In e\-commerce marketplaces / Amazon Seller Central Experience Must / No Freshers]  
**Min Skills:** Excellent Computer Skills, e\-Listing and Catalogue Management, 35\-45 WPM, Excel \& Google Sheets

**Job Overview:**

We are seeking a dedicated and detail\-oriented e\-Commerce Executive \[online Sales] for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of our online selling business. This includes managing product listings, brand analytics, inventory, customer service, order processing, and maintaining the online storefronts on platforms such as \[Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, Etsy, Myntra]. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in ecommerce, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to the fast\-paced nature of the online retail industry. We are open to bring talented people with proven experience from other industries and verticals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1\. Product Listings and Content Management:

o Create and manage product listings on ecommerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Etsy).

o Write compelling product descriptions, optimize titles, and create high\-quality images.

o Ensure listings are fully optimized for SEO to improve visibility and search rankings.

o Update product listings with accurate pricing, stock information, and product details.

o Regularly update product pages to reflect new arrivals, promotions, or sales events.

2\. Order Processing \& Fulfillment:

o Process and fulfill customer orders, ensuring timely and accurate shipment.

o Track orders to ensure on\-time delivery, managing any issues or delays.

o Coordinate with the logistics team or third\-party fulfillment services for order processing.

o Ensure proper packaging and labeling for shipping.

3\. Inventory Management:

o Maintain accurate inventory records, ensuring products are available for sale.

o Monitor stock levels and reorder products as needed.

o Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely product restocking.

o Perform regular inventory audits to minimize discrepancies.

4\. Customer Service \& Communication:

o Handle customer inquiries via email, live chat, or phone in a professional and timely manner.

o Resolve customer issues and complaints, aiming for high customer satisfaction.

o Process returns, exchanges, and refunds, adhering to company policies.

o Manage customer feedback and reviews, addressing any concerns promptly.

5\. Sales Reporting \& Analytics:

o Monitor sales trends, customer behavior, and inventory performance.

o Generate weekly/monthly sales reports to track KPIs and performance metrics.

o Analyze sales data to identify areas of improvement or new opportunities.

o Assist in the development of promotional strategies to boost sales.

6\. Social Media \& Marketing Support:

o Support social media campaigns by scheduling posts and engaging with customers.

o Help manage email marketing campaigns, including drafting content and tracking performance.

o Assist in creating promotional materials for special events, sales, or product launches.

7\. Platform Management:

o Stay up to date with best practices and new features on ecommerce platforms.

o Ensure adherence to platform policies and guidelines (e.g., Amazon Seller Policies, eBay Seller

Standards).

o Resolve any platform\-related issues, such as account restrictions or listing violations.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience:

o At least 2\-3 years of experience in ecommerce management or assistant roles, with a strong

understanding of online selling platforms (Amazon, eBay, Shopify, etc.).

o Proven track record of managing product listings, order processing, and customer service in an online

selling environment.

* Skills:

o Strong written and verbal communication skills.

o Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

o Knowledge of ecommerce tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Helium 10, Shopify, ShipStation, etc.).

o Familiarity with SEO techniques and strategies for ecommerce platforms.

o Experience with social media platforms and digital marketing strategies.

* Attributes:

o Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

o Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment.

o Strong problem\-solving skills and proactive attitude.

o Customer\-focused with a positive and professional approach to service.

* Education:

o Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field preferred but not required.

Additional Requirements:

* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast\-changing ecommerce environment.
* Experience with ecommerce software (e.g., Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, WooCommerce) is a plus.
* Knowledge of photography/editing software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Canva) is an advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Competitive salary and incentive structure.
* Opportunities for career advancement and personal development.
* Supportive and dynamic team environment.
* Comprehensive training and ongoing support.

If you are a driven and passionate individual with a knack for growth in online commerce industry, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to join our growing team as an e\-Commerce Executive / e\-Commerce Catalogue Manager (online Sales).

**More About Us?**

At Strat \& Wolf Private Limited, we have redefined the way brands are built and scaled in the digital age. As an online\-exclusive brand incubator, we have demonstrated our specialization in launching an innovative, high\-performance brand across various e\-commerce platforms. Our unique approach focused on identifying market gaps and creating a brand that resonates with today’s savvy online shopper.

In just four short years, Strat \& Wolf has proven the success of its model, achieving profitability and establishing a strong presence in the e\-commerce ecosystem. With a commitment to data\-driven decision\-making, creative branding, and strategic growth, we have successfully launched more than 2 brands that have achieved rapid traction in the competitive global marketplace.

Now, as we enter a new phase of growth, our focus is on scaling these two brands and later expanding our portfolio to outsiders who want to come to us to get their brands hedged. We leverage our expertise in digital marketing, product development, and online retail strategy to accelerate growth and drive long\-term success. At Strat \& Wolf, we believe in the power of innovation, agility, and relentless execution—traits that have propelled us forward and will continue to shape our future as we scale.

Join us on our journey as we continue to disrupt traditional brand\-building processes and pave the way for a new generation of online\-first brands.

**Collaboration**

* Maintain organized design files and documentation in Figma or similar tools.

**Learning \& Growth**

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory):**

* Knowledge of design systems or component\-based design.
* Exposure to animations, micro\-interactions, or motion design tools.

* Internship duration: **3 months**
* **Stipend: ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 per month (The final stipend amount will be determined based on the candidate's interview performance, skills, capabilities, and overall knowledge.**)
* **Post\-Internship Compensation: ₹2\.4 LPA – ₹3\.6 LPA (based on performance \& evaluation of Internship period)**

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
**Job Summary**
 JOB DESCRIPTION – Human Resources Director
   

  

 Location: New Delhi\- India
   

  

 Division: Ticketmaster
   

  

 Line Manager: Vice President, Human Resources
   

  

 Contract Terms: Permanent, 40 hours per week
   

  

 THE TEAM
   

  

 The Tech HR Team works closely with Tech, Product, Sports and Tournaments and Ticketmaster Music, business areas as well as the UK and Ireland region. As a team we help drive alignment on HR practices to achieve strategic business objectives while upholding Ticketmaster’s core values.
   

  

 HR professionals on this team develop meaningful relationships with employees across the business areas to foster equity and reinforce the continued adoption of HR best practices and delivery of business objectives. We drive evidence\-based decision making, leveraging people data, feedback, and context to provide strategic guidance to business leads.
   

  

 THE JOB
   

  

 The HR Director role is a leading role in our HR Business Partner function. Working with key stakeholders and leading the HRBP Team to help build organization and people capability, and shape and implement effective people strategies and activities within the organization. The HRD role has an excellent understanding of Ticketmaster’s organizational strategy, culture, vision, mission, values, and strategic objectives and helps galvanize the HR Team and business leads around these key components to Ticketmaster’s success.
   

  

 The role will be based in the New Delhi office directly supporting the client group based in India. The role’s primary function is to build partnership with business leads, to problem solve with them and to help build long term team success. The role requires being solution orientated, able to understand business challenges, and through discussion and partnership, help to build those solutions. Additionally the role will be responsible for identifying the long term success factors for the teams it supports, in order to then be able to identify the changes needed to ensure the team is able to achieve its goals. Through these two core responsibilities the role will be able to leverage the various resources and tools of Talent Management available, together with the support of partners within the business.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
**Talent Management**
* Partner with and provide direction to business leads on all aspects of talent management, organization design, role design, workforce planning, leadership development, and employee engagement.
* Work closely with the VP HR, hiring managers and Talent Acquisition, to establish and forecast people needs, establish staffing priorities, and direct related changes.
* Provide direction in senior management meetings in response to current and future departmental activities. Have a deep understanding of the objectives of the business and acts as partner on all people\-related matters.
* Oversee and design the on\-boarding process for the department or region.
* Identifying and evaluating turnover and retention and provide direction on focus areas to mitigate voluntary attrition.
* Analyze employee survey results and guide the leadership team(s) to develop departmental strategies based on feedback/results.
* Assist managers in designing the principles to identify their talent and the design of learning assessment tools
* Partner with the Learning \& Development team in the design and facilitation of training and education programs linked to development plans.
* Coach snr managers and employees on career development including the design of Development Plans
* Partner with managers and Compensation on Job Levelling to ensure consistent and maintained leveling integrity as well as facilitate the feedback on leveling design.
* Take ownership and oversee people data for the assigned client group.


**HR Partnerships**
* Partner with the Compensation \& Benefits teams on ad hoc issues as well as formal cycles related to promotions, bonus plans, and salary increases, including employee compensation equity and positions in need of re\-evaluation.
* Oversee implementation and aid in the design for the Company's performance management systems and compensation review programs for their divisions.
* Partner with the employee experience team on the initial design, oversee the implementation and follow up from employee surveys.
* Oversee and partner on the design principles on the creation of job descriptions and job analysis.
* Aid in the design of process for employee status change requests and paperwork.
* Partner on the design of policy for LOA’s.
* Be a point of escalation for complex benefits questions and refers employees to appropriate resources.
* Advocate and support use of Workday as a primary source of all HR Administration.
* Partner with Equity team on the implementation of Equity based initiatives and advocate for Equity within our organization.
* Provide input on which metrics to track as an HR group and utilize these metrics in decision making on tactical HR initiatives.


**Employee Relations**
* Conduct complex investigations of employee relations issues and resolve according to law, company policy and precedent, escalating as required.
* Oversee implementation of performance improvement plans across divisions and assist on complex terminations as appropriate.
* Ensure compliance with and communicate highlights to wider team of any legal or regulatory changes pertaining to labor, wage and hour, and employment laws, including manager communication/training.


**HR Consultation**
* Be the primary point of contact for assigned client groups to consult on routine and ad hoc questions around HR policy and people queries.
* Review, advise and direct on department design principles and creating effective environments for people.
* Review and design proposed people policies, providing the unique insight to how it can be operationalized.
* Oversee and aid in design on implementation of systems to improve people services.
* Provide HR direction and leadership to senior leaders.


**Team**
* Coordinate and/or manage work amongst more junior members of the HR team
* Coach other members of the team by providing advice and guidance on HR philosophy and practice
* Manage day\-to\-day operations of the HR function, and provide input for problem solving, consistency and/or action planning.
* Where applicable ensure development pathways and actively manage the performance of more junior members of the HR team


**HR Strategy**
* Take an active role in the input for design of HR Strategy
* Collate and facilitate feedback from the wider HR team and client groups on the practical benefits/challenges of HR initiatives for departments
* Provide suggestions to the HRLT on HR direction in any given focus area


**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**
* HR Certification or extensive experience
* Experience working in a large organization
* Experience with overseeing Talent Management systems and processes
* Experience overseeing complex Employee Relations cases
* Experience working in a multinational organization
* Extensive proven track record in an HRBP capacity and having held a Senior HR position
* Experience managing a small and/or large team of HR professionals at various levels
* Solid understanding of Indian employment legislation
* Excellent verbal and written communication in English, additional languages considered beneficial, given our global matrix
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.
* Familiarity with HRIS system(s) such as Workday is considered an asset


 YOU (BEHAVIOURAL)
   

  

* Reliability\- Ability to complete tasks on a consistent basis to a consistently good standard. As you progress through your career this will represent being able to handle an increasingly large, complex, and varied workload, balancing the prioritization of that load and maintaining on equitable approach to it as well.
* Leadership\- from a technical and strategic point of view, able to understand and devise strategies to lead the team forward but, leadership on an interpersonal level, helping teams with change management and coaching them through progress with effective communication.
* Adaptability\- an ability to pivot not just yourself to changing priorities but also ensure you are helping your team and colleagues with understanding and adapting to those changes. You will also have to deal with often competing priorities from client groups, with very different needs and sometimes culture. Shifting between those two worlds in a way that can balance efficiency of standard processes with bespoke outcomes.
* Problem Solving\- knowledgeable about the potential impacts on equity that your solutions can cause. Solving problems in a more systematic way and, less ad hoc in ways that can deliver outcomes equitably and with clear logic to justify them.
* Integrity\- HR must have integrity at its core. As an area that relies on employees to trust us in order to provide support in the most difficult of times. In the early parts of your career this will mostly focus on staying connected to our policies and processes to not waver and create inconsistency. As you advance in your career the complexity of problems faced will make decisions harder, but you will have to stay grounded and lean more on our philosophy and values to ensure you keep that level of integrity throughout the work we do. In the expert levels of your career, you will need to be able to demonstrate integrity at the highest levels of discussion representing our values and challenging senior leaders with the right questions and guidance centered on equity.
* People Management\- You will manage a large team across multiple time zones and regions, employing strategies that impact the whole team, managing and planning work across the whole team. In addition, you will be able to create development plans which span the whole team.
* Managing Relationships\- This will extend to managing relationships with leadership and exec levels around complex problems and projects.
* Teamwork\- You will understand the individual needs across the team and, how to best utilize the resources and tool available to prioritize initiatives to best deliver for the whole team. You can also measure and direct appropriate members of the team to support.


 LIFE AT TICKETMASTER
   

  

 We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.
   

  

 Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.
   

  

 We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Our Work Is Guided By Our Values**
**Reliability** 
 \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.
   

  

**Teamwork** 
 \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team
   

  

**Integrity** 
 \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent
   

  

**Belonging** 
 \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive
   

  

 EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES
   

  

 We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.
   

  

 Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.
