title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
The
 **Senior Manager – HR Generalist** 
 is responsible for end\-to\-end people operations, employee experience, and site governance for the assigned location. This role serves as the People \& Culture representative and single point of contact (SPOC) for all service lines operating from the site. This position collaborates closely with functional P\&C BPs on matters relating to performance management, employee relations, organizational changes, and leadership support. The role requires a seasoned HR professional who can lead the location independently, influence senior stakeholders, and ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging workplace environment.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Location Support** 




 •Lead and manage all HR activities at the site, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives and functional standards.
 



 •Serve as the HR SPOC for all service lines present at the location.
 



 •Represent HR in location governance forums, leadership reviews, and cross\-functional decision\-making.
 



 •Drive site\-level priorities in collaboration with Facilities, IT, Compliance, and Communications teams.
 



**2\. HR Operations, Compliance \& Governance** 




 •Oversee end\-to\-end HR operational processes including Onboarding documentation, workforce administration, HRIS updates, and compliance requirements.
 



 •Ensure adherence to statutory obligations, audits, workplace safety norms, and corporate policies.
 



 •Drive process excellence by identifying gaps, improving workflows, and ensuring quality and timelines are met.
 



 •Partner with central HR operations for smooth execution of processes like onboarding, exits, transfers, and payroll\-related inputs.
 



**3\. Employee Relations \& Case Management (in partnership with HRBP)** 




 •Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, behavioral issues, or workplace conflicts.
 



 •Conduct preliminary assessments, gather data, and partner with functional HRBPs for formal investigations or performance management cases.
 



 •Ensure cases are handled with fairness, confidentiality, and adherence to legal and policy frameworks.
 



**4\. Employee Experience, Culture \& Engagement** 




 •Design and lead the location’s employee engagement strategy\-events, culture\-building initiatives, community activities, and communication forums.
 



 •Drive periodic employee connects, pulse checks, and present insights to HRBPs and leadership teams.
 



 •Strengthen local culture by ensuring a safe, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.
 



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications** 




  





 •10–18 years of progressive
 **HR experience Generalist role, site lead** 




 •The ideal candidate should possess
 **strong facilitation skills, as the role will involve supporting induction programs and assisting the L\&E team in delivering various calendarized learning, engagement, and culture\-building initiatives.** 




 •Strong understanding of HR processes, compliance, employee relations, and multi\-stakeholder management.
 



 •Experience managing complex site operations or multi\-business\-unit environments preferred.
 



 •Ability to lead independently, manage escalations, and influence leaders without direct authority.
 



 •Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and decision\-making skills.
 



 •Hands\-on expertise in HRIS platforms, data reporting, and HR compliance frameworks.

description:
Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You Should Know About Us**
 Everllence, formerly known as MAN Energy Solutions, is a leading provider of propulsion, decarbonization and efficiency solutions for shipping, the energy economy and industry. True to our motto – ‘Moving big things to zero’ – we help key industries in the global economy to reduce hard\-to\-abate emissions. Our technologies have a measurable impact on the success of the global energy transition. Headquartered in Germany, Everllence employs around 15,000 people across more than 140 sites worldwide.
   

  

**HR Executive**
 The HR Executive will be responsible for supporting and coordinating key HR functions including recruitment and onboarding, time and attendance management, employee engagement initiatives, and training \& development programs. This role ensures smooth HR operations, contributes to a positive employee experience, and supports organizational HR initiatives.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage end‑to‑end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, scheduling interviews, and taking care of onboarding formalities such as BGV, Pre\-employment health checkup, and induction program.
* Monitor employee attendance and leave records, update HRMS, and prepare monthly reports for payroll.
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities, communication, and basic grievance support.
* Organize and track training programs, handle training logistics, and maintain training documentation.
* Maintain updated employee records and support HR processes as required.
* Support other HR operational activities assigned by the HR Manager.


**Skills Required**
* Strong communication (written \& verbal) \& interpersonal skills
* Self\-driven, responsible, and proactive with a strong follow\-up mindset.

 ****Director of People****

**About The Role**
* The Director of People will build the People function at Get Covered, supporting a growing team across multiple regions, including onshore and offshore employees. This role is ideal for a practical, thoughtful People leader who understands how to balance structure with speed in a startup environment.


**What You'll Do**

* Build, improve, and maintain scalable people processes that support company growth.
* Develop and manage HR policies, employee handbook updates, procedures, and internal people documentation.
* Ensure employee records, HR systems, onboarding materials, and compliance documentation are accurate and organized.

****Manager Support \& Employee Relations****

description:
**HR Business Partner – R\&D APAC**
**About Clearwater Analytics:**
 Clearwater Analytics (NYSE: CWAN), a global, industry\-leading SaaS solution, automates the entire investment lifecycle. With a single instance, multi\-tenant architecture, Clearwater offers award\-winning investment portfolio planning, performance reporting, data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, compliance, risk, and order management. Each day, leading insurers, asset managers, corporations, and governments use Clearwater’s trusted data to drive efficient, scalable investing on more than $6\.4 trillion in assets spanning traditional and alternative asset types.
   

  

 Our mission: To be the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform that simplifies the entire investment lifecycle and eventually revolutionizes the world of investing.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The HR Business Partner – R\&D APAC will serve as the primary strategic HR partner for Clearwater Analytics’ Research \& Development organisation across the Asia\-Pacific region, covering India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan. Based in Mumbai and reporting to the HR Head of India, this is a senior individual contributor role that partners closely with R\&D leadership to shape and execute a comprehensive people agenda that drives organisational effectiveness, talent excellence, and a high\-performance culture across five dynamic markets.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
**Strategic HR Partnership**
* Serves as the primary strategic HR advisor to R\&D senior leadership across India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan — translating business priorities into a cohesive people agenda that supports Clearwater’s engineering and technology growth objectives across the region.
* Engages as a thought leader on APAC people strategy, proactively surfacing regional market intelligence, talent trends, and competitive insights to inform R\&D leadership decisions.


**Talent Management \& Workforce Planning**
* Leads talent management processes for the R\&D APAC population including annual talent reviews, succession planning, career development frameworks, and high\-potential identification across all five markets.
* Partners with Talent Acquisition — APAC to define workforce plans, role architecture, and hiring strategies that meet R\&D scaling goals across India (Mumbai, Bangalore, Noida), Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, and Japan.
* Advises on grade\-level structures, technical career ladders, and compensation benchmarking frameworks specific to R\&D roles across diverse APAC talent markets.


**Employee Experience \& Engagement**
* Designs and drives employee engagement strategies tailored to the R\&D engineering population across APAC — identifying root causes of attrition and disengagement through structured listening, pulse surveys, and manager feedback channels.
* Champions a culture of inclusion, recognition, and psychological safety within APAC R\&D teams, partnering with managers on effective onboarding, integration, and long\-term retention of critical engineering talent.


**Performance Management \& Employee Relations**
* Guides R\&D managers through performance calibration, feedback frameworks, and improvement planning, while navigating complex employee relations matters with cultural sensitivity and alignment to local employment laws — including India’s Labour Codes and POSH Act, Singapore’s Employment Act, Australia’s Fair Work Act, Hong Kong’s Employment Ordinance, and Japan’s Labour Standards Act.
* Coaches and upskills APAC R\&D managers on people management fundamentals, navigating difficult conversations, and building high\-performing engineering teams.


**Organisational Design \& Change Management**
* Leads and supports organisational design, workforce restructuring, and change management initiatives within R\&D APAC — ensuring business\-driven decisions are executed with care for employee impact and in compliance with local regulations.
* Collaborates with COEs — Compensation, L\&D, Talent Acquisition, and HR Ops — to localise and deploy people programmes that address the specific needs of a fast\-growing, engineering\-first APAC population.


**HR Programme Leadership**
* Designs and delivers one or more high\-impact people initiatives annually — such as an APAC R\&D retention framework, technical career ladder, or manager capability programme — and represents R\&D APAC in global HR projects and working groups.
* Builds and tracks people strategy metrics for R\&D APAC — including headcount trends, attrition, capability gaps, and engagement scores — reporting regularly to the HR Head of India and R\&D leadership with data\-driven insights and recommended actions.


**Required Skills:**
* Strategic business acumen with the ability to connect people decisions to R\&D engineering outcomes and regional business growth.
* Strong consultancy and influencing skills — able to challenge and advise senior technical leaders with confidence across diverse cultural contexts.
* Hands\-on experience navigating employment legislation in two or more APAC markets (India, Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, Japan).
* Proficiency in HRIS platforms, particularly Workday; strong analytical capabilities with comfort working with HR data, dashboards, and people metrics.
* Skilled in change management, facilitation, and executive communication across time zones and cultures.
* Strong organisational and interpersonal skills; collaborative with proven relationship\-building ability across geographies and seniority levels.
* Strong computer skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Excellent attention to detail and strong documentation skills.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Exceptional problem\-solving abilities; project management proficiency with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**Education \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field; MBA or Master’s in HRM strongly preferred.
* SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or equivalent professional HR certification is an advantage.
* 12\+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 6–7 years in a dedicated HRBP role supporting Engineering, Product, or Technology functions in a global organisation.
* Proven track record of partnering with senior R\&D or technology leadership in a high\-growth, multi\-geography SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated experience managing employee relations, organisational design, and talent management across multiple APAC jurisdictions; prior exposure to India plus at least one other APAC market (Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong, or Japan) strongly preferred.


**Employee Benefits:**
* Employee Health Insurance and Wellness program.
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* Competitive salary, benefits, and special allowances in the compensation package.
* Continual learning and development opportunities for career growth.

title: Executive Plant HR
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities:**




**Key Accountabilities** 




**Manpower Planning, Budgeting and Management** 



* Understand PGP for the Unit and contribute to planning at the unit by developing manpower plans and related budgets basis personnel cost calculations (permanent \+ contract \+ recruitment \+ welfare budget)
* Oversee daily attendance and leave management of permanent workmen, assess impact on manpower availability and plan to hire contractual workforce to fill gaps
* Regulate manning ensuring adherence to standards as defined by the Head Office and aligned with Operational Performance Indicators
* Monitor and approve overtime costs being incurred; Track budgets monthly, identify deviations and make necessary adjustments
* Lead processing of payroll and payments based on attendance details of permanent workmen and contractual labour respectively



  





**Industrial Relations and Statutory Compliances** 
 \-
 


* Build and maintain healthy working relationships with the Unions, Regulators and Govt. bodies
* Support the Unit Head and Cluster HR Head with wage bill negotiations with the Unions
* Understand issues and requirements from Union stakeholders and facilitate effective grievance resolution
* Drive adherence to all statutory compliances (e.g. factories act, contract labour regulation, emp. state insurance act, PF, workmen bonus, gratuity)
* Draw up charge sheets, issue warning letters and lead conduct of domestic enquiries (on\-roll and contract employees) in case of disruption of brewery operations
* Coordinate with various regulatory agencies and government departments like Collector Office, CP Office, Local Police station, gram panchayat, etc. to organize inspections, conducting record\-checks, obtaining necessary approvals etc.



  





**Recruitment and On boarding** 
 \-
 


* Manage end to end recruitment at the brewery for positions up to the M5
* Determine open positions based on vacancies and new positions required to be filled. Create/update job descriptions for the positions to enable sourcing of potential candidates
* Coordinate and conduct interviews with potential candidates (including relevant Unit stakeholders for technical interviews)
* Obtain hiring approvals from the Unit Head, Cluster Head and HO team, as required
* Prepare the induction schedule for new joiners; Organize sessions for the and facilitate completion of documentation formalities as per requirement
* Manage brewery induction programs for management trainees



  





**Performance Management** 
 \-
 


* Drive performance management process across goal setting, mid\-year review and final review
* Resolve issues faced by departments in uploading goals on the system (SAP)
* Check cascade of goals from HODs to the team/reportees; Lead reassignment of goals, in case of employee departure and new\-joiners
* Facilitate quarterly discussions with HODs to review KRAs and performance on set targets by various Unit teams
* Contribute to grade revisions, promotion decisions during the final review stage of the performance management process



  





**Unit Admin. Management** 
 \-
 


* Understand admin requirements for the plant and draw up related budgets
* Share requirements for canteen with the vendor; Drive adherence to SLAs agreed upon by the vendor and resolve issues, as required
* Share requirements for transportation of employees (staff and operators) with the vendor; Drive adherence to SLAs agreed upon by the vendor and resolve issues, as required
* Oversee housekeeping at the unit and coordinate with P\&L team for contract workforce deployment based on manpower needed
* Oversee security management at both plants and facilitate implementation of a robust Security Management System



  





**Training and TPM** 
 \-
 


* Lead the education and training pillar of TPM assuming responsibility of upskilling of employees through trainings
* Conduct training needs identification based on defined competencies and skill mapping for employees. Prepare training calendar and oversee effective execution of trainings (internal and external)
* Participate in FI and Safety pillar as part of TPM implementation for the Unit

title: HR Specialist, HR Shared Services
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

**HR Specialist, HR Shared Services**
 The HR Shared Services Specialist serves as the first point of contact for employees and managers, delivering timely, accurate, and customer\-focused HR support. This role is responsible for resolving HR inquiries, completing HR transactions, and escalating complex cases as appropriate.
   

  

 This position plays a critical role in enabling consistent, high\-quality employee experience through standardized processes, self\-service adoption, and effective case management across a
 **global HR Shared Services model supporting APAC, EMEA, and US regions** 
 .
   

  

**Location: India, Gurugram**
**Functions**
* Serve as the initial contact for HR inquiries received through Vantive’s case management system (HRCentral).
* Respond to employee and manager questions related to core HR processes and policies, with a strong focus on Workday transactions and HRIS\-based activities.
* Provide clear guidance and education to promote self‑service and correct use of HR tools and resources.
* Support employees and managers across multiple geographies, ensuring consistent service delivery.
* Validate requests for completeness and accuracy prior to processing.
* Ensure data accuracy and compliance with defined HR data standards
* Support Tier 1 HR defensive audits, following established work instructions.
* Accurately document inquiries, actions taken, and outcomes within Vantive’s case management system (HRCentral).
* Identify issues requiring escalation and partner with Manager and key stakeholders as appropriate for escalation.
* Follow up on open cases to ensure timely resolution and positive customer experience.
* Utilize and contribute to HR knowledge base articles, FAQs, and job aids.
* Identify recurring issues or trends and flag opportunities for process improvements or knowledge enhancements.
* Support adoption of standardized processes, automation, and self‑service solutions.
* Support special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* A minimum of 5 years in HR.
* Basic knowledge of human resources including talent acquisition, benefits, compensation, organizational design/development, M\&A, employee communications, training and development, employee relations policies, etc.
* Experience working in an HR Shared Services or service center model.
* Exposure to HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday) and case management tools.
* Customer‑focused and service‑oriented approach
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Collaborative mindset with willingness to escalate appropriately

 Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information. Form Link

description:
**Working with Us**
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.
   

  

 Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

 This role is also responsible for payroll reconciliation activities, which involves reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies, and processing appropriate updates to ensure the feed from Workday to payroll is correct.
   

  

**Detailed Position Responsibilities**
* Maintain and/or approve all data pertaining to employee records (i.e., transfers, personal information, title changes, etc.) that are entered in Workday through Manager or Employee Direct Access.
* Complete pending new hire transactions in Workday HCM after the candidate is in Ready to Hire status in the ATS
* Support execution of employee movement, employee status, time off and leave absence, payroll, benefits/leaves, Performance Check\-ins, and compensation processes, by maintaining the accurate and on time data in Workday, relevant for the above processes
* Support the integrity of employee records and Workday data, assuring legal and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain supervisory organizations, organization assignments, and position titles in the Workday system
* Complete weekly payroll reconciliation reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies, and processing appropriate updates.
* Support new hire benefits enrollment including ensure all required documents are collected; Accurately enter benefit enrollment data into systems; Ensure that all benefit enrollment processes adhere to company policies, following the process: Address any issues or discrepancies related to benefit enrollment promptly and effectively.
* Support the global recognition program
+ Transaction Award Process where manual intervention is required, e.g. Calcel Award, moving awards to the next approval (to avoid delay in the award)
+ Bulk Upload process. This includes the review and approval process
+ Provide Bravo Report to business

* Support leave of absence transactions
+ Process requests for time and absence, Holidays, vacation request including individual or mass changes.
+ Escalation to Senior/Manager for when necessary to support resolution of inquiries.

title: Junior ML Engineer
description:
Bangalore · On\-site · 0–2 years · Immediate start
 



  





**The work** 




 We turn 360° walkthroughs of active construction sites into accurate 3D reconstructions, then run geometric and semantic reasoning over them — comparing what's actually been built against the design model, finding defects, tracking what changed. The data breaks in ways benchmarks never do: motion blur, bad lighting, heavy occlusion, half\-built structures that match no clean prior.
 



  





 You'll work directly with Kanao (CTO) on the core algorithmic problems underneath this. The scope is deliberately wide and moves as the research does. Recent and near\-term problems look like:
 


* Reconstruction from panoramic (e.g. INSV) video — SfM/MVS, neural reconstruction (NeRF, Gaussian splatting), depth estimation, and making any of it survive real capture conditions
* Registration — aligning reconstructions to each other and to the design model across time
* Algorithms over IFC / BIM — parsing, querying, and reasoning about building geometry and the relationships encoded in a building model
* Segmentation and detection on 2D and 3D construction data
* Whatever the highest\-leverage problem is that quarter — the role follows the research, not a fixed ticket queue



  





 This is not a call\-the\-model\-and\-ship\-the\-wrapper role. You're expected to understand what's happening underneath, and to invent when the off\-the\-shelf approach falls over — which, on this data, is often.
   





**What we're looking for** 



* 0–2 years, with one thing you've built that proves depth — a project, paper, competition (Kaggle, ICPC, research), or portfolio. We care more about how deep you went on one thing than how many things you've touched.
* Strong programming fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, complexity. You can reason about why your code is correct and what it costs.
* Strong ML Fundamentals. You can explain how the methods you've used actually work.
* Bias to action. Fast iteration, low ego, comfortable being wrong quickly and moving on.
* Bonus: hands\-on with 3D, computer vision, or geometry — point clouds, multi\-view geometry, camera models, SLAM, registration, anything in this space.



  





 We optimize for raw ability and fundamentals over specific\-tool experience. If you've never touched IFC or Gaussian splatting but you learn fast and reason cleanly, you're who we want.\=
 



  





**What its actually like here** 




 Small team, direct line to the CTO, no layers. You own problems end to end and watch them hit production fast. Cloud and GPU infra is there — use it well. Real data, real users, real constraints. Not a research sandbox.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send us one paragraph about something you find genuinely fascinating — a topic, field, or idea. It doesn't have to be ML or even technical. We want to see how you think when you're chasing something you care about: how deep you go, how you dig in, what you're doing in that area right now.
 



  





 Attach your resume and send both through the application link.
 



  





**Process** 



1. Resume screen
2. Intro call
3. Technical round 1 — work through real problems we actually face
4. Technical round 2 — deeper problem\-solving and fundamentals
5. Culture fit

 For organizations that provide these services, some of the most important work happens in the field — in neighborhoods, across open spaces, and along millions of last miles that criss\-cross the country.  To do this, Zinier has created a scalable platform powered by AI\-driven insights and intelligent automation that helps field service teams work smarter, better, faster, and more efficiently. title: DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer — Diigoo Tech
 



 Location: Hyderabad (Madhapur) · On\-site
 



 Type: Full\-time, starting with a 4\-month provisional period
 



 Reporting to: Founders / Senior Engineering
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 Everything we build has to run somewhere, stay up, and deploy without drama. That's you.
 



 We're an IT consulting and product\-delivery company that also runs its own infrastructure \- so your surface is genuinely wide. One week you're setting up CI/CD for a client's software, the next you're deploying ArthaChain nodes, and the week after you're managing distributed GPU compute across the NexaNet network. You'll own the pipelines, the cloud, the containers, the blockchain infra, and the uptime of all of it.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-trust role. Infra mistakes cost real money and real downtime, so we're hiring someone early\-career but genuinely capable \- someone who's actually deployed things, broken things, and fixed them, not just watched tutorials. We'll grow your depth fast, but you need real fundamentals walking in.
 



 If you're the kind of person who automates a task the second they have to do it twice, this is for you.
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities** 




 CI/CD pipelines
 



 Build and maintain automated build, test, and deploy pipelines for both our client software and our own products. Make shipping fast, safe, and boring.
 



 Cloud infrastructure (AWS \& GCP)
 



 Provision and manage our cloud environments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Own networking, compute, storage, and cost efficiency.
 



 Containers and orchestration
 



 Containerise applications with Docker and run them reliably on Kubernetes. Manage scaling, rollouts, and recovery.
 



  





**Blockchain infrastructure** 




 Deploy and maintain ArthaChain nodes and validators, and keep our consortium network healthy \- uptime, upgrades, and node operations.
 



 NexaNet distributed infrastructure
 



 Help run NexaNet's distributed compute layer \- managing GPU nodes, the connectivity layer, node provisioning, and keeping distributed capacity available and billable. This is a core, growing part of the role.
 



  





**Monitoring and reliability** 




 Set up logging, monitoring, and alerting. Own uptime, respond to incidents, and build the systems that catch problems before users do. Take on\-call as you mature.
 



 Secrets, IAM, and hardening
 



 Manage secrets, access control, and infrastructure hardening \- coordinating closely with the security team.
 



 Automation
 



 Automate everything that should be automated. If it's manual and repetitive, your instinct should be to script it away.
 



  





**Must\-haves (non\-negotiable on day one)** 




 These are the things we genuinely can't train around for an infra role:
 



  





 Linux \- you're comfortable on the command line and understand how a Linux system actually works.
 



 Networking fundamentals \- TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, load balancing, firewalls. You can reason about how traffic flows.
 



 A scripting language \- Python or Bash, well enough to automate real tasks.
 



 Cloud exposure \- hands\-on with AWS or GCP, even at a project or lab level. You know what EC2/compute, storage, and IAM are and have used them.
 



 Containers \- real, demonstrable Docker experience. You've built and run containers yourself.
 



 Version control \- Git, properly \- branches, merges, the works.
 



 Proof of work \- personal projects, labs, college work, or open\-source where you actually deployed and ran something. We need evidence you've done this, not just studied it.
 



 Education \- final\-year or recent graduate in B.Tech / M.Tech (CSE / IT) or equivalent. Strong self\-taught candidates with proof of work are equally welcome.
 



  





 We don't expect mastery of Kubernetes, Terraform, or blockchain infra on day one \- those we'll build. But the fundamentals above need to be real.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-haves (these move you to the front of the queue)** 




  





 Hands\-on with Kubernetes (even Minikube / a home cluster counts).
 



 Infrastructure as Code experience \- Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation.
 



 Experience with CI/CD tools \- GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
 



 Monitoring stacks \- Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar.
 



 Any blockchain node / validator experience, or running infra for crypto/Web3 projects.
 



 GPU / compute infrastructure experience \- CUDA setups, GPU scheduling, ML infra.
 



 Cloud certifications in progress \- AWS / GCP Associate\-level.
 



 A homelab, a self\-hosted setup, or a personal cloud project you can show off.
 



  





  





**You'll probably fit if** 




  





 You automate anything you have to do more than twice.
 



 You're calm when something breaks and methodical about finding out why.
 



 You read docs and changelogs for fun, and you have opinions about how things should be deployed.
 



 You'd rather a system never go down than be a hero who fixes it at 3 AM.
 



 You don't wait for permission to fix a fragile pipeline \- you flag it and fix it.
 



  





  





**Provisional period (includes training) — 4 months** 




 Everyone starts with a structured 4\-month provisional period. This is where you build the range the role demands across cloud, containers, and our own infrastructure.
 



  





 Month 1 \- Foundations. Environment setup, architecture walkthroughs, and tooling. Get comfortable with our cloud, repos, and deployment flow.
 



 Month 2 \- Pipelines and containers. Build and own a CI/CD pipeline and containerise a real service. Your first production deployment happens here, supervised.
 



 Month 3 \- Cloud and orchestration. Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, monitoring, and one supervised end\-to\-end deployment cycle.
 



 Month 4 \- Our infrastructure \+ capstone. Blockchain node ops and an intro to NexaNet's distributed compute. Deliver a capstone \- own the deployment and monitoring of one real component end\-to\-end.
 



  





 We measure your progress monthly and convert to full\-time based on what you've built.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Provisional period / training (4 months): ₹7,000 \- ₹10,000 per month
 



 Full\-time (post\-conversion): ₹3\.5 LPA \- ₹6 LPA
 



  





 Top performers also earn equity participation, accelerated promotion paths, and meaningful trust placed on them early.
 



  





**What you're walking into** 




  





 Real ownership. From day one of training, you'll touch production infrastructure that real customers and products depend on.
 



 A flat, fast\-moving team. You'll work directly with founders and senior engineers, not through three layers of management.
 



 Depth and breadth. You'll go deep on infra, but you'll also see how every other function works \- the team is small enough that you have to.
 



 Frontier infrastructure. You won't just run cloud servers \- you'll help operate a consortium blockchain and a distributed GPU compute network. Very few early\-career engineers get to touch this.
 



 Long\-term upside. Top performers see equity participation, accelerated promotion, and real trust placed on them early.
 



  





  





**About us \- the short version** 




 We're a Hyderabad\-headquartered technology company with two sides. We're an IT consulting and product\-delivery firm \- building software for businesses and delivering large\-scale systems to government agencies through partner channels \- and we build our own sovereign infrastructure: ArthaChain (our consortium blockchain), VOXLOR NEXUS (sovereign AGI infrastructure), and NexaNet (distributed compute and connectivity).
 



 Our delivery work spans everything from healthcare systems to retail commerce platforms deployed across the United States.
 



  





 "
 *We're not your average startup. We're founder\-led, Gen\-Z, and building products that genuinely matter \- for India, and for the world. If you want a job, we have those. If you want a craft, that's what we're really hiring for."*

description:
Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Noida

 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. **About The Role**

**What Success Looks Like**

* Build collaborative relationships with the Service Delivery team and understand common escalation patterns.



**First 6 months**

**Career Pathways**

 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
 



 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
 



 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
 



 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. title: Cyber Security Specialist
description:
Security Engineer (Generalist) — Diigoo Tech
 



 Location: Hyderabad (Madhapur) · On\-site
 



 Type: Full\-time, starting with a 4\-month provisional period
 



 Reporting to: Founders / Senior Engineering
 



  





**What this role actually is** 




 We're a startup, so we're not hiring a security architect, a pentester, and an analyst as three separate people. We're hiring three security engineers who can each do all of it.
 



 Every person we bring on owns the full picture \- architecture, engineering, testing, analysis, incident response, and compliance. One week you're designing how a system should be secured, the next you're breaking it to prove it isn't, and the week after you're analysing logs to catch what got through. No "that's not my job" \- here, all of it is your job.
 



  





 If you've ever opened DevTools and wondered why a website lets you do something it shouldn't, you already have the mindset. The rest is craft \- and we'll sharpen it together.
 



 The attack surface is genuinely wide: enterprise platforms, cloud\-hosted SaaS, on\-prem deployments, and blockchain infrastructure \- some of it shipping to government bodies and international clients.
 



  





**Roles and responsibilities** 




 You'll own all of the following. Not a slice \- the whole thing.
 



 Security architecture
 



 Design secure\-by\-default systems across our web apps, APIs, cloud, and blockchain stack. Threat modelling, defining trust boundaries, and building defence\-in\-depth into the design before code is written.
 



 Security engineering
 



 Harden our AWS and GCP environments \- IAM, network policies, secrets management, and audit trails. Build and maintain the controls, not just recommend them.
 



 Offensive testing
 



 Run vulnerability assessments and pentests on our web apps and APIs. The OWASP Top 10 is your warm\-up. Find the holes before anyone else does.
 



 Security analysis and monitoring
 



 Set up and run SIEM, intrusion detection, and incident\-response playbooks. Read the logs, spot the anomaly, and lead the response when something fires. Take on\-call once you're ready.
 



 Blockchain security
 



 Review smart contracts and consortium\-chain configs (Solidity, Rust, validator security) for re\-entrancy, oracle attacks, and validator compromise.
 



 Compliance and audit
 



 Drive our posture across DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001 readiness, SOC 2 prep, and government\-grade audits.
 



 Code review and security culture
 



 Sit in on code reviews and catch security mistakes before they ship. Run internal phishing simulations and security training. Yes, that includes the founders.
 



  





**Must\-haves (non\-negotiable on day one)** 




 These are the things we genuinely cannot train around. You need them walking in.
 



  





 Core fundamentals \- TCP/IP, TLS, DNS, HTTP, Linux, and a scripting language (Python or Bash). Not surface\-level \- you can actually reason about how these work.
 



 Hands\-on offensive basics \- real, demonstrable experience with the classic web vulnerabilities: SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, broken auth. Projects, CTFs, or TryHackMe / HackTheBox all count.
 



 Tooling \- you've used Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, or Wireshark properly \- not just watched a tutorial.
 



 Cryptography basics \- hashing, symmetric vs asymmetric encryption, signatures, and certificates.
 



 Cloud literacy \- you understand how a cloud environment (AWS or GCP) is structured and where it breaks \- IAM, networking, secrets, logging.
 



 Reporting \- you can write a vulnerability report an engineer can reproduce and fix without a follow\-up meeting.
 



 Generalist mindset \- you're comfortable being a one\-person security team for whatever the day demands, and learning whatever you don't yet know \- fast.
 



 Education \- final\-year or recent graduate in B.Tech / M.Tech (CSE / IT / Cybersecurity) or equivalent. Strong self\-taught candidates with proof of work are equally welcome.
 



  





 We don't expect mastery of every discipline on day one. We do expect real depth in the fundamentals and the range and hunger to close the rest quickly.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-haves (these move you to the front of the queue)** 




  





 Smart\-contract auditing experience or knowledge of blockchain\-specific attacks (re\-entrancy, oracle attacks, validator compromise).
 



 Hands\-on with cloud security tools \- AWS Inspector, GuardDuty, Wiz, or Prisma.
 



 Certs in hand or in progress \- CEH, Security\+, eJPT, or OSCP.
 



 A HackerOne or Bugcrowd profile, even with a single accepted report.
 



 Open\-source contributions to security tools, or published CTF write\-ups.
 



 Exposure to compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, DPDP) in a real setting.
 



  





  





**You'll probably fit if** 




  





 You break things on purpose \- and then write down exactly how.
 



 You read CVEs for fun and have at least one favourite vulnerability class.
 



 You're comfortable wearing every security hat in a small team and switching between them in the same week.
 



 You don't wait for someone to file the ticket. You file it yourself.
 



  





  





**Provisional period (includes training) — 4 months** 




 Everyone starts with a structured 4\-month provisional period. This is where you build the range the role demands \- you'll learn and apply all of it, not just one corner. The training is structured, not improvised, and we measure your progress monthly.
 



  





 Month 1 \- Foundations. Lab setup, architecture walkthroughs, and a tooling bootcamp.
 



 Month 2 \- Web and API security. Work on live staging environments. Your first reproducible report is due here.
 



 Month 3 \- Cloud security. Cloud hardening, IAM review, and one supervised end\-to\-end pentest cycle.
 



 Month 4 \- Blockchain and capstone. The blockchain security module, plus a full security audit report on one internal component.
 



  





 Conversion to full\-time is based on what you've built during these four months.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Provisional period / training (4 months): ₹7,000 \- ₹10,000 per month
 



 Full\-time (post\-conversion): ₹3\.5 LPA \- ₹6 LPA
 



  





 Top performers also earn equity participation, accelerated promotion paths, and meaningful trust placed on them early.
 



  





**What you're walking into** 




  





 Real ownership. From day one of training, you'll touch production work that ships to actual customers.
 



 A flat, fast\-moving team. You'll work directly with founders and senior engineers, not through three layers of management.
 



 Depth and breadth. You'll specialise in your craft, but you'll also see how every other function works \- the team is small enough that you have to.
 



 A serious commitment to your growth. The 4\-month training is structured, not improvised. We measure progress monthly and convert based on what you've built.
 



 Long\-term upside. Top performers see equity participation, accelerated promotion, and real trust placed on them early.
 



  





  





**About us \- the short version** 




 We're a Hyderabad\-headquartered technology company building across two ambitious frontiers. On one side, an AI\-native ERP and Business Operating System for the next generation of businesses. On the other, sovereign\-grade infrastructure \- consortium blockchain networks and the connectivity layer beneath them.
 



 We also run a consulting and product\-delivery arm that works with government bodies and international clients, building everything from large\-scale healthcare systems to retail commerce platforms deployed across the United States.
 



  





*"We're not your average startup. We're founder\-led, Gen\-Z, and building products that genuinely matter \- for India, and for the world. If you want a job, we have those. If you want a craft, that's what we're really hiring for."*

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
**The Opportunity** 

 We are looking for a passionate and skilled
 **Embedded Systems Engineer** 
 to join our growing innovation team. You will be at the heart of some of the most exciting and impactful dental technology projects in the country — working on real hardware products that will reach clinics, patients, and markets.
 



 What makes this role truly special: you will be working in close collaboration with
 **INDQ Product Design Studio** 
 — one of India's most experienced and respected industrial product design firms with extensive expertise in MedTech product development. This is a rare opportunity to work alongside senior designers, engineers, and dental experts in an end\-to\-end innovation environment.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 

 As an Embedded Systems Engineer at Dentic World, you will:
 


* Design, develop, and test embedded firmware for smart dental devices and oral care hardware products
* Work on microcontroller\-based (ARM Cortex, ESP32, STM32, AVR etc.) systems for dental/medical applications
* Develop firmware for sensor integration — including IMU, pressure sensors, ultrasonic transducers, optical sensors, and biosensors used in dental diagnostics
* Implement BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy), Wi\-Fi, and NFC\-based wireless communication protocols for connected dental devices
* Collaborate closely with mechanical, industrial design, and clinical teams to integrate electronics into compact, ergonomic form factors
* Develop and debug PCB\-level hardware, work with schematics and circuit design in collaboration with hardware engineers
* Write clean, well\-documented, real\-time firmware (RTOS\-based where applicable) for prototype and production\-grade dental devices
* Support proof\-of\-concept (PoC) builds and iterative prototype testing in collaboration with the INDQ Product Design Studio
* Interface with dental SMEs (Subject Matter Experts) and clinicians to understand clinical requirements and translate them into technical specifications
* Ensure compliance considerations for medical\-grade embedded systems (IEC 62304, ISO 13485 awareness preferred)
* Contribute to Bill of Materials (BOM), design reviews, and technical documentation



  




**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 

**Education:** 



* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or related discipline
* M.Tech / M.E. preferred but not mandatory



**Technical Skills (Must\-Have):** 



* Proficient in C / C\+\+ embedded programming
* Experience with microcontrollers: ARM Cortex\-M series, STM32, ESP32, Arduino, or similar
* Hands\-on experience with UART, SPI, I2C, USB communication protocols
* BLE / Wi\-Fi firmware development experience
* Ability to read and work with circuit schematics and PCB layouts
* Experience with debugging tools: JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers



**Good to Have:** 



* Experience in medical device firmware development
* Knowledge of RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar)
* Familiarity with signal processing, ADC/DAC interfacing, and sensor fusion
* Android/iOS app connectivity via BLE (SDK\-level)
* Exposure to IEC 62304 or ISO 13485 for medical software/hardware



**Experience:** 
 1–4 years of hands\-on embedded systems experience (freshers with exceptional project portfolios may also be considered)
 



  





  




**What You'll Get** 
* 🦷 A front\-row seat to building India's dental technology ecosystem from the ground up
* 🔬 Work on real, meaningful hardware products that impact oral health at scale
* 🤝 Direct mentorship and collaboration with
 **INDQ Product Design Studio** 
 — senior MedTech product design professionals
* 🚀 Fast\-paced, startup environment with room to grow, lead, and innovate
* 🏆 Opportunity to co\-create products that could be patented, commercialised, and reach global markets
* 🌐 Exposure to international dental markets and global clinical partnerships
* 💡 A culture that values curiosity, ownership, and bold ideas

 INDQ is one of India's premier industrial product design firms with deep expertise in MedTech, healthcare devices, and human\-centred design. With years of experience bringing complex medical and consumer hardware products to life, INDQ's team of senior designers and engineers will work alongside our embedded engineers in a highly collaborative innovation environment.

 Interested candidates are encouraged to apply directly via LinkedIn or send their resume and portfolio to:
 



 📧 careers@denticworld.com

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the company:** 




 Dezerv is a house of investing solutions for high\-net\-worth and affluent Indians. Dezerv is co\-founded by Sandeep Jethwani, Vaibhav Porwal, and Sahil Contractor. They have led successful wealth management businesses and managed over USD 7 billion in assets. The Dezerv team brings together decades of investing expertise from leading global financial institutions like JP Morgan, UBS, BNP Paribas, etc. Our team of experts monitors the performance of portfolios and rebalances them if required to ensure long\-term success. We are backed by marquee firms like Premji Invest, Accel, Elevation, Matrix, etc. Since inception, our clients have trusted us with over 16000 Crs of their assets.
 



  





**Why are we building Dezerv?** 




 Investing is stressful and emotional. Building \& growing wealth is difficult and time\-consuming. Most individuals struggle with managing their investments and money. Our goal is to help individuals grow their wealth without the stress, time, and costs involved in a traditional investment. At Dezerv, we are building a platform that leverages our decades of investment expertise to help individuals invest better for their future.
 



  





**Who will you be working with?** 




  





 You’ll be joining a product team that thrives on collaboration and innovation. Our team includes startup veterans from Urban Company, CRED, PhonePe, IIFL Wealth and more. The talent density here means that no one feels like the smartest person in the room—every day is a chance to learn, push boundaries, and grow.
 



  




* Sripad Panyam, Head of Product (Ex\-Urban Company)
* Krishna BS, Head of Engineering (Ex\-Amazon)
* Adil Siddiqui, Head of Design (Ex\-PhonePe)
* Debleena Mukhopadhay, Product (Ex\-IIFL Wealth)
* Arnab Dey, Product (Ex\-Urban Company)
* Siddharth Krishnamurthi, Product (Ex\-IIFL Wealth)
* Ankit Gupta, Product (Ex\-Navi)
* Tejas Balasubramanya, Product (Ex\- CRED)



  





  





**About the role** 




 This isn’t just another Product Manager role—this is a chance to build something that’s never been built before. At Dezerv, we’re creating a wealth management experience that blends technology and human connection in ways no one else has done. You’ll work with teams across design, engineering, and business to craft solutions that redefine how affluent Indians manage their wealth.
 



 As a Product Manager at Dezerv, you won’t just own a product—you’ll own outcomes. Whether it’s through elegant problem\-solving or sheer determination, you’ll wear many hats, from sales to operations, to ensure success. Here, you’ll shape the future of wealth management by tackling complex challenges across investments, user engagement, and more. If you’re expecting to only run tech sprints, this isn’t the role for you.
 



**As a Product Manager – Investment execution at Dezerv, you will:** 



* Own end\-to\-end product flows for
 **investment execution (eg. payments, SIPs, settlements, reconciliations, etc)** 
 and
 **client reporting** 
 ensuring high reliability and accuracy.
* Build a revolutionary wealth management experience that scales.
* Drive impact by owning the product and the path to success. Autonomy and decision\-making power are at your fingertips.
* Inspire cross\-functional teams with your ideas, energy, and leadership.
* Grow alongside Dezerv, as your responsibilities expand and your contributions directly shape our P\&L



**You maybe a good fit if** 



* You’re humble but assertive.
* You take ownership and get your hands dirty.
* You communicate clearly and frame problems to influence your team.
* You don’t follow a "by\-the\-book" approach—you focus on getting things done.
* You are great with data.
* You have 1\-4 years of experience in Analytics/Consulting/Product Management.

title: Science Writer
description:
JoVE is the world\-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Convert author\-submitted manuscripts into clear, accurate, and engaging voiceover transcripts and video scripts.
* Collaborate with authors to guide their manuscripts through the JoVE video creation process.
* Proofread and review the video scripts to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and error\-free content.
* Interpret scientific comments, feedback, and requirements accurately and implement necessary changes with precision.
* Utilize AI\-assisted writing and editing tools effectively as part of the content development workflow.
* Review journal protocol videos to ensure scientific accuracy and adherence to publication standards.
* Assess author feedback on rough video drafts and effectively communicate required revisions to the video editing team.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict production timelines.
* Follow established guidelines and maintain high\-quality standards throughout the script development process.
* Take initiative to identify and propose process improvements that enhance efficiency and content quality.



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* PhD in biology, molecular biology, bioengineering, chemistry, or a related natural science discipline.
* 1\-3 years of experience in scientific communication, technical writing, or educational content creation.
* Experience in teaching or content/curriculum development is preferred.
* Strong scientific and technical vocabulary with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated strength in editing and proofreading.
* Ability to apply AI\-assisted tools in writing, editing, or content development workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify scientific inaccuracies in written and visual materials.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask, prioritize, and work effectively under pressure.
* Ability to follow detailed guidelines and consistently meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional production teams.
* Enthusiasm for science and a willingness to learn about new research areas and visual communication methods.
* A record of original research published in peer\-reviewed scientific journals is strongly preferred.



  





  





**Why Join JoVE?** 




  




* A competitive compensation package.
* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Business Analyst II, Account Integrity
description:
**Description**
 Have you ever thought about what it takes to detect and prevent unauthorized activity among hundreds of millions of eCommerce transactions across the globe? What would you do to increase trust in an online marketplace where millions of buyers create and sign in to shop at Amazon? How would you build systems that evolve over time to proactively identify and neutralize new and emerging MO?
   

  

 Amazon’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) team is looking for a passionate, results\-oriented Business Analyst to support Account Integrity’s mission is to prevent bad actors from taking over existing good Customer accounts (events referred to as ATOs), and from creating new Amazon accounts (bad actor accounts, or BAAs).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Business Analyst in BRP, you will be responsible for analyzing terabytes of data to identify specific instances of risk, broader risk trends and points of customer friction, developing scalable solutions for prevention. In addition you will be responsible for building a robust set of operational and business metrics and will utilize metrics to determine improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Understand the various operations across BRP
* Understand the requirements of stakeholders and map them with the data sources/data warehouse
* Design and develop highly available dashboards and metrics using Tableau, Excel and SQL.
* Provide wing\-to\-wing project lifecycle execution (project planning, execution, risk assessment and system availability)
* Execute high priority (i.e. cross functional, high impact) projects to improve operations performance with the help of Operations Analytics managers
* Perform business analysis and data queries
* Execute analytical projects and understanding of analytical methods (like ANOVA, Distribution theory, regression)
* Identify new pattern of abuse and make recommendations for new controls and improved monitoring
* Develop and oversee the initiation of strategy recommendations


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* 5\+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3\+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

 Business Requirements Analysis

**Summary**
 Business Analyst (Life Sciences R\&D)
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with a strong background in Life Sciences R\&D, supporting domains such as Clinical, Regulatory, and/or Patient Safety. The role is responsible for managing business requirements, change requests, and system enhancements across R\&D IT applications, ensuring effective translation of business needs into scalable, compliant solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have 5\+ years of experience in Life Sciences, hands on exposure to R\&D IT systems, and proven ability to work closely with application configuration and support teams to coordinate the design, development, and delivery of system features and changes. Proficiency with change and delivery management tools such as Jira and ServiceNow is essential.

* Coordinate the development, testing, and delivery of features and system changes
* Support prioritization, impact assessment, and traceability of requirements across R\&D systems
* Manage and track changes using Jira and ServiceNow

**About the Role**
 The Data User Platform and Programs team works at the intersection of data infrastructure, reliability, governance, developer tooling and AI systems, supporting thousands of internal data users including engineers, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders.

* Platform foundations for reliability, observability, cost\-efficiency and compliance

title: Software Engineer II- Front End
description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture.
   

  

 Within Azure Data, the messaging and real\-time analytics team provides comprehensive solutions and a robust platform that enables users to ingest high granularity signals (real\-time \& observability) and complex data, converting those into a competitive advantage in real\-time for both end users and modern applications.
   

  

 We’re Azure Messaging – a rapidly growing group of around 40 engineers – and we’re experts at moving hundreds of millions of small packets of information into and out of the cloud, per second. We work on the cutting edge of distributed messaging systems, where milliseconds latency, massive throughput and 99\.99% service availability aren’t tradeoffs – they’re all necessary. Our infrastructure needs to be resilient enough for financial transactions, rapid enough for streaming and gaming applications, and still nimble enough to move many petabytes of data per day.
   

  

 We build the Azure Service Bus (http://aka.ms/servicebus), Azure Event Hub (http://aka.ms/eventhub), Azure Event Grid (http://aka.ms/azureeventgrid) and Fabric RTI Eventstreams (http://aka.ms/eventstream) services, which help power Microsoft SaaS applications like Office 365, Xbox Live, Halo, Application Insights (and many, many more), as well as thousands of external Microsoft customers. Our group fosters a diverse, inclusive and collaborative work culture that prioritizes people at all times.
   

  

 We’re looking for a creative, dedicated Software engineer II to help us build our next set of customer\-facing web experiences. You will be instrumental in prototyping and building a new UX platform through which customers would interface with the vast ocean of streaming data. Your work would address high\-profile customer pain points and form a core piece of our UX plane.
   

  

 We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Developing highly polished components and experiences.
* Efficient prototyping of UX designs, working both with and without designers.
* Consistently iterating on previous designs based on end user and stakeholder feedback.
* Using data to determine compelling improvements to existing experiences for delighting users.
* Experimenting and developing wireframe proposals for new features or products.


 Embody our culture and values
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required/Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.
* 1\+ year professional experience working with Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or data platforms within Azure, GCP or AWS


**Job Requirements: Other \& Additional**
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
   

  

* This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

We are looking for a self\-driven and ambitious Executive Assistant to join our team! As an Executive Assistant to CEO, you will support managers and employees through a variety of tasks related to organization and communication.

You will be reporting directly to the CEO, as an Executive Assistant to the CEO you will be responsible to provide executive, administrative, and development support to the CEO, as well as the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) and HR.

* Excellent management, time\-management, and problem\-solving skills.

Location: NCR Region (Manufacturing / FMCG Packaging Unit)

Department: Human Resources \& Administration

Reporting To: Plant Head / Unit Head

Industry: FMCG Packaging / Manufacturing

Role Summary

The HR \& Admin Manager will be responsible for end\-to\-end Human Resource Management, Industrial Relations, Statutory Compliance, Administration, Government Liaison, Customer HO Coordination, Billing as per production SKUs, and overall workforce productivity management of the FMCG packaging unit. The role ensures smooth plant operations through robust HR systems, compliance adherence, and effective coordination with stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1\.⁠ ⁠Statutory Compliance \& Legal Management

Ensure compliance with all applicable Central \& State labour laws and factory regulations.

Maintain and monitor compliance under:

Factories Act

EPF, ESIC

Minimum Wages Act

Payment of Wages Act

Bonus Act

Gratuity Act

Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act

POSH Act

Shops \& Establishment Act (if applicable)

Haryana Labour Laws

Coordinate statutory audits and inspections.

Maintain statutory registers and records (physical \& digital).

Timely filing of returns and renewal of licenses.

Handle legal notices and represent management during inspections.

Labour Department

Local Administration

Manpower deployment confirmation

Productivity tracking

Service level agreements (SLA)

SKU\-wise packaging work done

Manpower deployment

Agreed rates and productivity norms

Ensure timely submission and follow\-up for payment realization.

5\.⁠ ⁠Talent Acquisition \& Manpower Planning

End\-to\-end recruitment for:

Blue collar workforce

Supervisors

Ensure timely onboarding and documentation.

Maintain workforce database and attrition analysis.

6\.⁠ ⁠Payroll \& Compensation Management

Ensure accuracy in:

Attendance \& overtime

Statutory deductions (PF, ESIC, PT, TDS)

Bonus and incentives

Coordinate full \& final settlements.

Ensure compliance with wage structures as per minimum wages notifications.

Handle payroll audits.

7\.⁠ ⁠Productivity \& Performance Management

Monitor manpower productivity as per SKU\-wise output norms.

Implement performance tracking systems.

Coordinate with production team for:

Manpower optimization

Cost control

Absenteeism reduction

Suggest improvement initiatives for operational efficiency.

8\.⁠ ⁠Training \& Development

Identify training needs across levels.

Conduct induction programs for new joiners.

Arrange statutory and safety training.

Implement skill development programs for packaging operations.

Maintain training records and compliance documentation.

9\.⁠ ⁠Administration \& Facility Management

Oversee plant administration and facility upkeep.

Manage security, housekeeping, canteen, and transport vendors.

Maintain employee welfare facilities.

Ensure safety and hygiene standards in coordination with EHS team.

Asset and inventory control for admin\-related materials.

10\.⁠ ⁠Record Management \& Documentation

Maintain employee personal files and digital records.

Maintain statutory registers and attendance records.

Document policies, SOPs, and compliance files.

Ensure data confidentiality and audit readiness.

We are looking for a talented Node.js Backend Developer to join our team in Dehradun. * GitHub profile with backend projects.
* Experience building scalable SaaS, ERP, CRM, Billing, Inventory, or Marketplace platforms.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture.
* Experience with WebSockets and real\-time systems.

title: HR Executive
description:
Job Overview:

We are looking for a dynamic, result\-oriented, and passionate **Full\-time IT HR Executive / Manager** to join our growing tech company in Tirupati. You will be responsible for sourcing top tech talent, managing employee relations, designing performance incentives, and building a vibrant workspace culture.

If you have a startup mindset, excellent negotiation skills, and a solid understanding of IT recruitment, we want to talk to you!

Key Responsibilities:

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Source, screen, interview, and onboard technical talent (Python/Flask Developers, UI/UX Designers, Sales Executives, Interns).
* **Employee Management:** Track daily attendance, manage leaves, and oversee day\-to\-day office administration.
* **Performance \& Incentives:** Monitor team performance and implement structured incentive programs to boost motivation and productivity.
* **HR Policies \& Operations:** Draft official offer letters, Non\-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), and build company policy guidelines from scratch.
* **Team Engagement:** Conduct regular feedback sessions and organize team\-building activities to maintain high morale and employee retention.

Requirements \& Qualifications:

* **Education:** MBA in HR, B.Tech, or any graduate with relevant IT HR experience.
* **Technical Sourcing:** Familiarity with job portals (Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn) and technical terms (Python, Databases, Web Frameworks).
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in **English** and **Telugu**.
* **Skills:** Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and multitasking abilities.
* **Mindset:** Highly proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup culture.

Benefits:

* Opportunity to lead the HR department of an upcoming AI \& Software startup.
* Direct mentorship from the Director.
* Friendly and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Performance\-based bonuses and career advancement.

description:

Arbeidsspråk
  
Norsk
  
  

Søk senest søndag 21\. juni
  
  

Vil du være med å utvikle fremtidens HR i offentlig sektor?
  
Vi søker en engasjert og utviklingsorientert spesialkonsulent til vår lønnsavdeling. Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å videreutvikle lønnsprosesser i en moderne offentlig virksomhet.
  
Stillingen passer for deg som har kompetanse innen lønn og fraværsadministrasjon, samtidig som du motiveres av forbedringsarbeid, digitalisering og utvikling av fremtidens arbeidsprosesser.
  
  

Lønn og fraværsavdelingen er en intern fellesfunksjon og leverer sammen med hele HR, tjenester innenfor drift, forvaltning og utvikling av arbeidsgiverfunksjonen i kommunen. Vi er ca 35 ansatte som jobber tverrfaglig innenfor fagområdene rekruttering, kompetanse, arbeidsrett, lønn og tariff, pensjon, arbeidstidsplanlegging, personalsaker, IA, HMS og lærlinger.
  
  

Arbeidsoppgaver
  
  

Vi ønsker deg som vil bidra til utvikling, vedlikehold og optimalisering av systemer og forbedring av rutiner og prosesser.
  
Rådgivning til virksomhetene og deltakelse i utvikling internt, og for organisasjonen i sin helhet, er en naturlig del av oppgavene HR leverer.
  
  

**Hovedarbeidsoppgaver:**  

* Lønnsarbeid for egne virksomheter
* Kontrollerfunksjon knyttet til system og fag
* Rådgivning til virksomhetene knyttet til fagområdet
* Rapportering internt og til offentlige myndigheter
* Lønnsoppgaver i hele prosessen tilknyttet lønnsarbeidet
* Jobbe med utviklingsarbeid og internkontroll

Relevant høyere utdanning innen HR, administrasjon, økonomi eller tilsvarende
  
Erfaring fra lønnsarbeid og HR\-administrasjon, gjerne fra offentlig sektor
  
God kjennskap til relevant lov\- og avtaleverk
  
Erfaring med HR\- og lønnssystemer
  
Interesse for digitalisering, automatisering og utviklingsarbeid
  
God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  
Personlige egenskaper
  
  

**Vi ønsker oss en medarbeider som:**  

* er nysgjerrig, tar initiativ og jobber selvstendig
* ser muligheter i teknologien og digitale arbeidsformer
* jobber godt i team og som liker å spille andre gode
* er flink til å kommunisere og er strukturert i gjennomføringen av arbeidsoppgavene dine
* jobber selvstendig, og liker å jobbe utadrettet mot ledere og medarbeidere i kommunen
* har interesse for fagfeltet, og som tør å gå inn i komplekse problemstillinger

Om bedriften
  
Sammen skaper vi Sarpsborg! Det er vår visjon, og sammen jobber vi hver dag for at våre innbyggere skal ha gode dager. For å klare dette, trenger vi dyktige medarbeidere.
  
  

Her i Sarpsborg kommune jobber vi etter verdiene framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig. For å levere gode tjenester og skape gode arbeidsmiljøer skal alle ansatte vise handling gjennom å våge, lede, lære, mobilisere og samarbeide. Dette er beskrevet i vår plattform for ledelse og medarbeiderskap, som vi har valgt å kalle for «Vi i Sarpsborg». Les hele plattformen «Vi i Sarpsborg her».
  
  

Over 60 000 innbyggere bor i Sarpsborg og hos oss i kommunen har vi cirka 6\.900 fast ansatte og 4\.200 årsverk (tall fra 2026\). Her skal det være godt å bo, jobbe og besøke. Vil du søke jobb hos oss og være med på å utgjøre en forskjell for andre?
  
  

Sarpsborg kommune ønsker medarbeidere med ulik faglig, sosial, etnisk og geografisk bakgrunn.
