title: Head of Onboarding, Strategic Accounts
description:
**About Plum**


Plum is India's leading employee health benefits platform. We cover 600,000 lives across 6,000 companies, growing 80% year on year, cash\-flow profitable in FY27, and recently closed our Series B backed by Peak XV, Tiger Global, and Tanglin.

**1\. The Charter**


Insurance in India still remains a hairy problem. No trust. Overcomplicated systems. Too much paperwork. Communication gaps. Commoditisation. Complication. Manual processes. Opacity. Too much fine print. Warped policies. Scamming. Too many hiding features. Loopholes. Fear. Intimidating processes.


Plum is fixing this. The first 30 days are where trust is built or lost. Your job is to make those 30 days exceptional: for every HR admin, and every employee on their team. What we want to build is a seamless, high\-touch activation journey for every employer and employee — from the moment they sign with Plum to the end of their first 30 days. Not a support queue. Not a checklist. A **red carpet.**

**Your job is to lead this charter, from vision to execution.**

**2\. Why It Matters for Plum**


First impressions are permanent. The first 30 days are when customers decide whether Plum is a *vendor* or a *partner.*


When activation is poor, renewals are transactional. When activation is exceptional, customers become advocates — the kind who renew without negotiation and refer without being asked. Every percentage point of activation gain directly compounds into retention, NPS, and revenue.


We believe the Red Carpet Experience is a growth lever, not an operational cost. Done right, it makes our Account Management team's job easier, our support team's job lighter, and our customers' lives genuinely better.

**3\. What you will do**

* Lead the team which will own and manage the onboarding process for our most important customers from pre\-sales through successful onboarding closeout
* Partner closely with Account Managers and Insurers to ensure smooth customer handoff experience
* Understand customer goals and successfully manage their onboarding timeline towards value
* Report on metrics and customer feedback to assess the impact of successful onboarding and to help identify new customer initiatives and product opportunities
* Help the team deliver live and scalable training sessions customized to customer maturity and needs
* Understand and consult on product and industry best practices in order to act as a trusted advisor to our customers and inspire new possibilities using our product

***Key outcomes you will chase will be the % of customers who achieve the below states in the first 30 days***

* **80%\+** **Activation**


Employees 'Insurance Ready' — app downloaded, profile complete
* **NPS 80** **Advocacy**


Claims NPS target for all first\-month claims
* **3\+** **Viral Loop**


Employees proactively praising Plum to their HR team

**5\. We’d love to hear from you if you have:**

* Strong problem solving skills (ideal experience of 3\+ years at McKinsey, Bain or BCG)
* Total experience of 7\-8 years and above
* Team management experience (can run a large team)
* Deep desire to build with AI (some experience is preferred)
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders at both Plum and insurers to deliver for customers
* Very strong written and verbal communication and high numeric ability
* High customer empathy
* Proven project management skills and experience working with multiple customers / on multiple items concurrently

title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Plum**


Plum is on a mission to make health insurance simple, accessible, and genuinely useful for modern organizations. Backed by Tiger Global and Peak XV Partners, we've built a product people love and now we're scaling it to reach 10 million lives by FY2030\.

**About the Role:**


We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager who can own non\-tech hiring while also leading select mid–senior hires that need sharper judgment, strong stakeholder partnership, and thoughtful candidate engagement, and also has experience in managing teams.


This role sits at the intersection of scale and quality, for someone who knows how to move fast without cutting corners.

**Your Role:**


As a Talent Acquisition Manager, you will own hiring across a wide range of **non\-tech roles** (Sales, Account Management, Finance, HR, Marketing, and similar functions).

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Hiring Ownership**


	+ Lead end\-to\-end hiring for non\-tech roles, planning and executing hiring waves aligned to business demand while maintaining strong funnel health, speed, and conversion.
	+ Own select mid–senior roles, partnering with hiring managers to sharpen role clarity and interview plans, and conducting deeper screening conversations focused on capability, intent, and role fit.
* **Stakeholder Partnership**


	+ Work closely with hiring managers to prioritise roles and timelines
	+ Set clear expectations and provide regular, data\-backed updates
	+ Push back when required with context and solutions
* **Sourcing Strategy**


	+ Build and diversify sourcing pipelines using job boards, referrals, social platforms, and networks
	+ Adapt the sourcing approach based on role complexity and urgency
* **Data \& Reporting**


	+ Track hiring metrics across bulk and mid–senior roles
	+ Use data to identify bottlenecks and improve predictability
	+ Share insights to support workforce planning

**What You Bring**

* **Experience**


	+ Minimum of 6 years of talent acquisition experience
	+ Strong experience hiring across non\-tech roles
	+ Proven ability to balance bulk hiring with nice hiring
	+ Experience in handling teams
* **Hiring Judgment**


	+ Knows when a role needs speed vs depth
	+ Comfortable switching between high\-volume and high\-touch hiring
* **Execution \& Ownership**


	+ Gets into the detail and follows through
	+ Reliable, proactive, and accountable
* **Communication \& Influence**


	+ Strong stakeholder and candidate communication skills Confident pushing back and managing expectations
* **Tools \& Data**


	+ Hands\-on experience with ATS and recruitment tools
	+ Uses data to drive hiring decisions

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
**About Us**

Agho IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a growing IT and Digital Solutions company specializing in E\-commerce Marketplace Management, Software Development, Digital Marketing, ERP Solutions, and Business Automation Services. We help businesses establish and grow their presence across leading online marketplaces.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and result\-oriented Marketplace Manager to manage and grow our clients' online marketplace businesses. The ideal candidate will be responsible for handling marketplace operations, product listings, sales growth strategies, advertising campaigns, inventory management, and customer experience across multiple e\-commerce platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage seller accounts on Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Shopsy, eBay, Myntra, Ajio, and other marketplaces.
* Create, optimize, and maintain product listings.
* Monitor product catalog performance and improve product visibility.
* Manage inventory synchronization and stock updates.
* Handle order processing, returns, cancellations, and customer queries.
* Plan and execute promotional campaigns and marketplace advertisements.
* Analyze marketplace sales reports and generate performance insights.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and market trends.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams to ensure smooth marketplace operations.
* Ensure compliance with marketplace policies and guidelines.
* Resolve account health, listing suppression, and operational issues.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.

**Required Skills**

* Experience in Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Knowledge of Meesho, Shopsy, eBay, Myntra, and other marketplaces.
* Strong understanding of e\-commerce operations and online sales.
* Knowledge of marketplace advertising and promotions.
* Excellent analytical and reporting skills.
* Strong communication and client\-handling abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, E\-commerce, or related field.
* 1–5 years of experience in Marketplace Management or E\-commerce Operations.
* Freshers with excellent marketplace knowledge may also apply.

**Preferred Skills**

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Job Description**  

Purpose of the role – mission


The Data Scientist role is responsible for designing and leading universe studies, setting up the extrapolation for Retail Panels, discussing and designing rawdata modelling for non\-coop retailers, and supporting root\-cause analysis in case of client’s complaints when related to these activities.


This role requires strong data fluency, analytical skills with the ability to assess data relevance, and a deep understanding of retail panels and their value.


Key activities:


1\. Universe Studies:

* Design and lead universe studies, acting as a “project manager” for these studies.
* Document methodologies for transparency and provide clear explanations of selected methods.
* Validate the universe estimation.
* Conduct impact analysis of universe studies where relevant.


2\. Extrapolation:

* Design and simulate extrapolation setups for new panels.
* In case of major change in the sample of a channel, redesign its extrapolation matrix, conduct impact analysis where relevant.
* Support StatOps team in case of minor events (how to select a donor shop for a copy shop or a create shop, how to slightly update the extrapolation in case of e.g. empty cell, discuss quality issues / risks in case of weak / weaker sample).
* Assess the compliance of the existing design of extrapolation matrix and eventually recommend improvement (in the design, the sample size \= recommend target for recruitment, etc.)
* Specify sample checks per country\_channel and ensure that they are properly executed by Operation teams.
* Jointly with Operation, review the quality of the existing extrapolation and recommend / redesign if necessary (feedback loop from MDQC teams).
* Update the Target Sample File every year and in case of significant change in the universe or the sample.

  

3\. Modelling:

* Assess the feasibility of non\-coop retailer rawdata modelling outside of the system: business interest (in collaboration with Product), availability of data sources, usability of modelling components
* Design the solution, test the development, review the quality once implemented, review every year the relevancy of the solution
* Once implemented, handover to Operation for ongoing maintenance and execution.
* Support Commercial teams and Client Operation to explain the methodology of a Rawdata modelling.


4\. Quality and Projects

* Implement new country\-channel setups, including reviewing channel definitions, designing universes and samples, and providing setup instructions.
* Resolve Level 2 methodology clarification issues.
* Support Major Data Change required by a redesign recommended by Data Science (major change in the universe, major redesign of an extrapolation, major redesign of a rawdata modelling): support the definition of the action plan, support the client communication.
* Participate to Data Science regional and global projects

 **Qualifications**  

Skills and Qualifications:

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in statistical modeling and data analysis.
* Ability to document and explain complex methodologies clearly.
* Familiarity with root cause analysis methods (such as 5\_why method)
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Knowing production processes for PoS
* Extensive experience of working in an international environment
* Strong quality orientation and solution driven
* Strong command of the English language

  

This role is ideal for individuals with a keen eye for detail and a passion for data and data science. If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and have the skills listed above, we encourage you to apply for the Data Scientist position.

 **Additional Information** **Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

title: SRE
description:
**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented
 *Site Reliability Engineer* 
 (SRE) to ensure the reliability, availability, and performance of Vegapay's production systems. The ideal candidate will be responsible for monitoring applications and infrastructure, managing production alerts, overseeing critical end\-of\-day processing and driving incident resolution through effective triage and escalation.
   

  

*The Hats You Will Wear*
* Monitor application health checks and ensure high system availability.
* Monitor infrastructure health, including servers, databases, network components, and cloud resources.
* Continuously track Grafana dashboards to identify performance bottlenecks, traffic spikes, and production anomalies.
* Monitor and manage end\-of\-day (EOD) batch processing jobs, scheduled tasks, and cron executions.
* Monitor end\-of\-day reporting jobs and ensure timely completion of core system and operational reports.
* Review, acknowledge, and respond to production alerts across monitoring platforms.
* Create, manage, and track incidents through closure, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
* Perform initial triage, coordinate with engineering teams, and follow the escalation matrix for issue resolution.
* Maintain incident logs, post\-incident documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in on\-call rotations and support critical production activities when required.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency improvements.


**The Perfect Fit**
* 2\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Support, DevOps, or Infrastructure Operations.
* Hands\-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience monitoring scheduled jobs, batch processing systems, and cron\-based workflows.
* Knowledge of incident management processes and production support best practices.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-availability production environment


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
   

  

 This is where we come in.
   

  

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.

mittoX (Vindox Services Private Limited) — Indiranagar, Bengaluru

About the programme:

The Job Market Ready Programme is not a typical internship. It is a 3\-month, learn\-by\-doing experience built for people who are serious about changing careers, picking up real industry skills, and becoming someone companies actually want to hire — or staying and building with us.

You will work on live projects across AI automation, sales, operations, and partnerships at mittoX — a fast\-growing AI\-powered cross\-border mobility platform. There are no department boundaries. You go where the work needs you.

**What you will do**

* Work across real functions — AI tools, outreach, partner ops, content, and systems

* Stretch into extra hours when the work demands it — not because someone is watching
* Own at least one project end\-to\-end by month 3
* Learn by doing, not by attending training sessions

**Programme timeline**

* Week 1: Onboard, understand the business, pick your first focus area
* Months 1–2: Deliver across multiple tracks with increasing ownership
* Month 3: Lead an end\-to\-end project — this becomes your proof of work
* End of month 3: Earn your certificate \+ receive active job assistance

What you get

* Industry\-recognised certification from mittoX upon successful completion of 3 months
* Active job assistance — we will help you land your next role
* Founder\-led mentorship — direct access to the founding team, zero bureaucracy
* Real work on real products — no mock briefs, no simulated tasks
* First shot at a permanent full\-time role if you earn it (see below)

**You can steal a permanent job here**

If you show up, stretch, and deliver consistently across 3 months — there is a real full\-time seat available. We would rather hire someone who has already proven themselves inside the company than go looking outside. Earn it and it is yours.

**Who we are looking for**

We do not hire based on degrees or years of experience. We hire based on proof.

**You must:**

* Communicate clearly and confidently in English and at least one regional language (written and spoken)
* Have built or shipped something real — a prototype, a project, a tool, a product demo. It does not need to be polished. It needs to be yours.
* Have led something — a college fest committee, a student body, a community group, a sports team. You know what ownership costs.
* Have volunteered or served in a real\-world setting — NGO, community initiative, freelance work, or a family business. Life experience counts more than a grade here.
* Be the kind of person who stretches into extra hours because the problem matters, not because a manager is watching.
* Be entering a trade or switching careers and be serious about it — not just collecting internship lines on a CV.

**What this programme is not**

* Not a fixed\-schedule 9\-to\-5 internship
* Not a single\-department role — you will work across AI, sales, and ops
* Not a paid holiday — compensation is outcome\-based, tied to what you deliver
* Not for people who need hand\-holding to get started

Pay is outcome\-based. What you deliver is what you earn. High performers who convert real business results and complete the 3\-month programme will be considered for a full\-time permanent role with a fixed salary.

* Which skills you are bringing and what track interests you most (AI, Sales, or Ops)
* One thing you have built, led, or done in the real world that you are proud of

title: Human Resources Intern
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Akoode Technologies is a global software development company that transforms ideas into high\-performance digital products. Headquartered in Gurgaon, India, with a strong presence in the USA, the company delivers custom software, AI\-powered mobile applications, and scalable enterprise platforms for complex business needs. Akoode leverages advanced technologies including AI, blockchain, IoT, big data, and 3D solutions to build intelligent, data\-driven systems. A team of certified professionals with strong technical and analytical backgrounds focuses on quality, agility, and accountability, ensuring fast turnaround times and dependable delivery. Cross\-functional creative and engineering teams work closely with clients to provide end\-to\-end solutions that are both technically robust and aligned with business goals.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 This is a full\-time, on\-site Human Resources Intern role based in Gurugram. The Human Resources Intern will support day\-to\-day HR operations, including assisting with recruitment activities such as posting job descriptions, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and coordinating candidate communication. The intern will help maintain employee records, support onboarding and documentation, and assist in implementing HR policies and procedures. Daily responsibilities may also include coordinating employee engagement activities, helping track attendance and leave, and supporting benefits\-related queries under the guidance of senior HR team members. The role involves preparing basic HR reports, assisting with compliance documentation, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure a positive and efficient employee experience.
 



  





 6 Month internship with stipend.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Foundational understanding of Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with an interest in building a career in people operations.
* MBA 2026 Pass .
* Basic knowledge of HR Policies, Employee Benefits, and Personnel Management, or a willingness to learn these areas quickly.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, on\-site environment.
* Proficiency with MS Office or Google Workspace; familiarity with HR software or applicant tracking systems is an advantage.

* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with a high level of professionalism.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and quality.
* Proactive problem\-solver with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 At Mimecast, we operate at scale—protecting billions of emails daily across a global hybrid\-cloud infrastructure. If you’re passionate about reliability, automation, and working with cutting\-edge technologies in a mission\-critical environment, this is the place for you.
   

  

**AI\-First Engineering at Mimecast**
 Mimecast is an AI\-First engineering organization. Our teams actively leverage AI\-powered development tools across all facets of engineering, from code development to testing, documentation, and operations. We're looking for leaders who don't just use AI tools but champion their adoption and establish new ways of working.
   

  

 Our AI leadership extends beyond how we build to what we build. Our Mihra AI agent delivers 7x faster threat response for customers, and we're recognized as "Agents of Change" in Human Risk Management. Engineers here work at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI tooling and AI\-powered security products that protect organizations worldwide.
   

  

**Why Join**
 “This is a hands\-on role in a team that’s focused on ensuring the reliability and resiliency of Mimecast’s Hybrid Cloud infrastructure. You’ll work with Kubernetes, AWS, and other exciting technologies, while building automation and Infrastructure\-as\-Code solutions to drive efficiency and scalability. If you’re eager to tackle complex challenges and grow your career in a collaborative environment, I’d love to hear from you.” – Hiring Manager, Cloud Platform
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Sustain platform resiliency: Perform infrastructure configuration and maintenance to ensure optimal performance, security, and availability.
* Maintain containerization platforms: Manage Kubernetes and AWS EKS to provide a stable platform for Mimecast’s microservices.
* Build automation: Develop reusable Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and automation to streamline infrastructure provisioning.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues: Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues across Linux and Kubernetes systems in a hybrid\-cloud environment, minimizing downtime.
* Enhance security: Maintain the security posture of infrastructure and platform configurations, aligning with the latest cybersecurity standards.
* Collaborate and refine processes: Work closely with the team to improve operational processes and documentation.
* Manage observability tools: Operate and maintain tools like Graphite, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic, Nagios, and LogScale.
* Support engineering teams: Provide exceptional support to internal Product and Engineering teams, meeting their requirements for Mimecast’s Cloud Platform.
* Participate in on\-call rotation: Be part of the on\-call rotation and perform out\-of\-hours maintenance work as needed.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Technical expertise: Experience in roles such as Platform Engineer, Cloud Operations, Sys Admin, or Site Reliability Engineer (SRE).
* Kubernetes proficiency: Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and containerization in production environments.
* Linux expertise: Strong skills in maintaining and troubleshooting Linux operating systems and distributed systems at scale.
* Infrastructure knowledge: Foundational understanding of core infrastructure services like DNS, Identity Management, load balancers, and web servers.
* Networking basics: Foundational knowledge of computer networking.
* IaC and scripting: Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools like Terraform/CloudFormation and configuration management tools like Puppet. Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language.
* Proactive mindset: A willingness to take on new challenges, deliver results, and learn new technologies quickly.
* Collaboration skills: Outstanding communication and social skills, with the ability to connect with others and problem\-solve effectively.


**What We Bring**

About us

 **Cordia®** 
 , a healthcare app used by real care teams to manage patient profiles, care plans, diet plans, prescriptions, and the admin tools behind them. Our platform helps healthcare providers deliver more coordinated, personalized, and data\-driven care for people living with chronic conditions. By combining modern software engineering with international healthcare standards such as FHIR, we’re making digital healthcare more connected, scalable, and accessible for both clinicians and patients.
 



  




 About the role
 
 This is a trainee role designed for someone early in their career. You’ll start by fixing bugs and building small features on a live product, and we’ll grow you into a strong full\-stack developer over time. You’ll work closely with senior developers, designers, and our backend team, with mentorship along the way.
 



 You’ll join as a trainee, and as you find your feet and show what you can do, we’ll bring you on as a full\-time, permanent member of the team. Growing you into that role is the goal from day one.
 



 You don’t need to know our full stack on day one. If you have solid fundamentals and a real appetite to learn, we’ll teach you the rest.
 



  




 What you’ll actually need
 

 •    
 
 A genuine interest in learning to code well — most of what you need for this job, you’ll learn here
 




 •    
 
 Comfort with at least one programming language and the basics of how the web works (HTML, CSS, and how a browser talks to a server)
 




 •    
 
 Attention to detail and clear communication — you can explain what you did and ask good questions

 An interest in building software that helps healthcare teams
 



 A CS or related degree is welcome, but so is a bootcamp, self\-taught background, or any path that got you here.
 **If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, please still apply.** 




  




 What you’ll learn and work with

 •

 — components, routing, and forms
 




 •    
 
**HTML, CSS \& Bootstrap** 
 — building responsive, accessible UI
 




 •    
 
**REST \& GraphQL APIs** 
 — connecting the interface to backend data
 




 •    
 
**Git** 
 — branches, pull requests, and code reviews
 




 •    
 
**Testing** 
 — writing and running automated tests so your changes ship with confidence
 




 •    
 
**AI coding \& design tools** 
 — you’ll have hands\-on access to modern AI tools for both building and designing, and learn to use them effectively and responsibly
 




 •    
 
**AWS and RxJS** 
 — useful later on; a plus if you’ve seen them, but we’ll teach you
 



  




 What you’ll do
 

 •    
 
 Fix bugs and build small UI features on patient\-facing workflows
 




 •    
 
 Work with designers and backend developers to ship real functionality
 




 •    
 
 Write clean, readable code and learn our codebase over time
 




 •    
 
 Write and maintain tests for the features and fixes you ship
 




 •    
 
 Test your changes on desktop and mobile
 




 •    
 
 Learn to handle patient data carefully and responsibly — we’ll show you how
 



  




 Nice to have
 

 •    
 
 Any web project from college, an internship, or your own time — show us a repo, a side project, or anything you’ve built
 




 •    
 
 Some UX/UI design sense, or experience with Figma — a plus, not a requirement
 




 •    
 
 Any exposure to Angular, React, or another modern framework
 



  




 What we offer
 

 •    
 
 One\-on\-one mentorship on Angular, AWS, and healthcare workflows
 




 •    
 
 Hands\-on work on a live product, not throwaway exercises
 




 •    
 
 Access to AI coding and design tools as part of your everyday workflow
 


* •    
 
 A clear path to grow into a full\-stack web developer

title: Scrum Master - Planning & Execution
description:
**What You’ll Do** 
  

  

* Lead and facilitate 2\-3 Scrum teams, each composed of 7\-9 members including software developers, QA engineers, and a product owner.
* Champion and ensure team understanding and adherence to the Team Agreement, Definition of Ready, and Definition of Done.
* Collaborate closely with product owners to ensure a clear understanding of business objectives within features and user stories.
* Expertly facilitate core Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, release planning, daily stand\-ups, stakeholder demos, and sprint retrospectives.
* Actively support the product owner in the continuous development, maintenance, and refinement of the product backlog.
* Proactively identify and eliminate impediments and blockers to maintain high team productivity.
* Manage and coordinate dependencies with other internal teams to ensure smooth workflow.
* Provide transparent metrics and regular team health status updates.
* Mentor team members in the adoption and consistent application of Agile/Scrum best practices.
* Diligently track, report on, and facilitate the resolution of identified issues and risks.
* Implement and support change practices within the team.
* Track key team performance indicators such as velocity, volatility, predictability, and cycle time, and use these metrics to drive continuous team improvement.
* Provide exemplary support to the team through servant leadership and by consistently leading by example.
* Utilize Jira proficiently to create insightful dashboards, filters, and reports for team visibility and tracking.
* Protects the scrum process and prevents distractions
* Ensures the proper front door process is followed
+ Captures risks and issues, and escalates to P\&E Tribe Lead as needed

* Provides squad\-level status to the P\&E Tribe Leads on a bi\-weekly basis or as needed (UDF)
* Facilitates Scrum/Kanban ceremonies including:
+ Work intake planning and management
+ Backlog refinement/prioritization
+ Daily stand\-ups
+ Reviews and demos
+ Retrospectives
+ Team capacity planning (velocity, burndown charts, estimation)
+ Partnering with P\&E Tribe Lead or P\&E Segment Lead to facilitate quarterly planning

* Partners with the P\&E Tribe Lead to support the Planning \& Delivery Framework, including tool usage, processes, standards, etc., focusing on: (Jira process)
+ Squad capacity monitoring and management
+ Delivery tracking and release management
+ Blocker removal support


**What Experience You Need**
* Scrum/Agile Experience: 1–3\+ years of direct experience as a Scrum Master, preferably in software development, is standard.
* Prior Roles: Strong candidates often have 3–5 years of experience in related roles such as project management, business analysis, or engineering.
* Key Skills for the Role
* Conflict Resolution \& Problem Solving: Ability to remove impediments and manage team dynamics.
* Leadership \& Communication: Strong skills in influencing without authority.
* Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with ALM tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps).
* Education: A Bachelor’s degree in IT or a related field is commonly required.


 Scrum.org \+4
   

  

* Coaching \& Facilitation: Proven experience in mentoring teams, coaching Product Owners, and facilitating Scrum events (retrospectives, planning, etc.).
* Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) are highly preferred.
* Technical Understanding: While not always required to code, experience in software development, testing, or technical environments helps.


 Reddit \+6
   

  

**What Could Set You Apart**
* Impediment Removal: Focuses solely on clearing roadblocks outside the team's control (e.g., bureaucratic bottlenecks, external dependencies) rather than just tracking tasks.
* Servant\-Leadership : Prioritizes team needs and supports them in becoming self\-organizing and cross\-functional.
* A great Scrum Master is not a taskmaster or a secretary, but an agent of change who empowers teams to be as productive and self\-sufficient as possible.
* Focus on Process over "What": Enables the team to determine how to deliver the product, guiding them on Scrum framework adoption, whereas product owners focus on what is being built.
* Coaching \& Mentoring: Guides the team and organization to understand and adopt Agile practices, fostering continuous improvement.
* Conflict Mediation \& Culture: Acts as a neutral facilitator to resolve conflicts and creates an environment where teams feel safe to raise issues.
* Relationship Networking: Moves beyond the team to navigate the broader organization, improving cross\-team collaboration.


 LinkedIn \+7

**Program Manager (Scrum Master)\- Chennai, India**




 So where do you fit here? NielsenIQ clients span the globe and require technology teams’ Scrum Masters that can connect the dots for their technology needs. As a Scrum Master at NielsenIQ, you will be responsible for helping our product and technology teams drive product development adopting standard and consistent SAFe Agile practices ensuring high quality. You will coordinate efforts across functional, technical and process teams and work cross\-functionally to solve client problems. Your teams may cut across time zones, datasets and technologies and it will be your responsibility to keep track of all the moving parts, bring people together across multiple teams and communicate with various stakeholders, including senior management.
   

  





 At NielsenIQ, we empower our Scrum Masters to drive results and change. We are looking for motivated, analytical, dynamic candidates with a passion for data and technology to join our Program Management Office. * Resolves team impediments with other Scrum Masters to increase the effectiveness of the application of Scrum in the organization

* Demonstrated experience facilitating meetings at multiple levels of an organization and an understanding of facilitation techniques
* Bachelor’s degree and 10\+ years of software development experience in an Agile environment with 3\+ years of Scrum Master experience

title: Business Analyst / Product Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 We're a Webflow design and development agency serving B2B and SaaS clients. Our delivery stack runs on a no\-code foundation — Webflow, Airtable, Softr, Xano, Memberstack, n8n — and we're increasingly layering AI into everything we do, with Claude as our primary tool.
   

  

 We're hiring someone who blends Business/Product Analyst and Product Manager DNA — sitting at the intersection of strategy, design, and engineering. You'll take vague client problems and drive them through discovery, wireframing, documentation, build coordination, and launch. On the PM side, you'll think in roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, define what success looks like, and own outcomes — not just outputs. This applies to both client projects and our own internal products.
   

  

 This is not a role for someone learning the ropes. We need 3\+ years of real BA, PM, or equivalent experience — you've scoped projects, written PRDs and SRS documents, run UAT, prioritized backlogs, handled stakeholders, and shipped things that went live.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
*Discovery \& Client Strategy*
* Run discovery calls with clients. Translate business problems into clear scope, constraints, and dependencies.
* Write approach documents, SRS, formal proposals, and budget reports.
* Own stakeholder engagement and solution evaluation end\-to\-end.
* Bid on RFPs — craft well\-scoped, compelling responses.


*Product Management*
* Own product strategy and roadmap for both client builds and our internal products.
* Write PRDs, define MVP scope, and prioritize features against business goals — not just feature requests.
* Define success metrics for what you ship and follow up to see if they were hit.
* Run customer feedback loops: synthesize user interviews, support tickets, analytics into clear product decisions.
* Maintain backlogs. Run sprint planning. Make hard calls on what doesn't get built.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform positioning and feature decisions.


*Design \& UX*
* Sketch UX wireframes for Webflow designs and internal tool builds.
* Drive user\-centred design (UCD): user research, personas, user flows, journey maps, information architecture.
* Prototype in Figma, Whimsical, Miro — whatever gets the idea across fastest.
* Run user testing before shipping.


 Documentation \& Delivery
   

  

* Write user stories, flow charts, and UML diagrams that the dev team can build from without needing clarification.
* Coordinate with developers to ensure specs are understood and the build matches the intent.
* Run UAT. Maintain BA artefacts. Keep project documentation accurate and current.


*Systems \& AI*
* Use Claude daily as a working collaborator — for drafting specs, generating user stories, analyzing feedback, writing proposals, and automating repetitive work.
* Design and build internal systems: Airtable bases, Claude\-powered workflows (MCP, Claude in Chrome, Cowork, Claude Code), automation pipelines that connect our stack.
* Treat repetitive tasks as automation candidates. If you did it twice, the third time should be a system.
* Research emerging no\-code and AI tools, pilot the ones that matter, drop the ones that don't.


**Required**
* 3\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Solutions Architect, or equivalent role. Freshers will not be considered.
* Product thinking. You've owned a product or feature end\-to\-end — not just gathered requirements. You can defend why something should or shouldn't ship, and you measure outcomes after launch.
* Communication: 8/10 or better. This role is customer\-facing. You write clean emails, run discovery calls without rambling, and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical founders.
* Hands\-on experience with Claude or similar AI tools. Not surface\-level use — you've built workflows, used Projects, and ideally touched MCP, Claude Code, or comparable agent tooling. If you can't show us how you've used AI to actually do work, this isn't the role for you.
* Systems thinking. You see patterns, build repeatable processes, and document what you figure out.

title: Security Engineer (Required Skills - Application Security & Threat Modeling)
description:
**Responsibilities:** 




**SDLC Integration and AppSec Tooling** 



* Support the day\-to\-day operation of application security tooling across SAST, DAST, SCA (software composition analysis), secrets detection, and container image scanning.
* Help onboard new applications and repositories into AppSec tooling; configure scan policies and validate that pipelines are correctly instrumented.
* Assist with tuning of detection rules and policies to reduce false positives and improve signal quality for engineering teams.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, and quick\-reference guides for AppSec tooling and processes.



**Findings Triage and Vulnerability Management** 



* Triage findings from AppSec tooling — validate, prioritize by risk and exploitability, deduplicate, and route to the appropriate engineering owners.
* Perform false positive validation on tooling findings — review code context, data flow, and exploitability conditions to confirm whether reported issues are genuine; document rationale for any findings marked as false positive or suppressed.
* Feed false positive patterns and suppression decisions back into tooling configuration, custom rules, and triage playbooks to continuously improve scan quality and reduce developer noise.
* Track open vulnerabilities through to closure; follow up with developer teams on aging findings and SLA adherence.
* Produce regular metrics and reporting on AppSec tooling coverage, finding volumes, false positive rates, mean\-time\-to\-remediate, and trends; flag emerging risk patterns.
* Support coordination of remediation for high\-impact open\-source and supply\-chain vulnerabilities (e.g., critical CVEs in widely used libraries).



**Secure Code Review and Developer Enablement** 



* Participate in secure code reviews for new and changing applications under the guidance of senior architects, focusing on OWASP Top 10 and similar common weakness categories.
* Partner with developers to explain findings, recommend fixes, and answer "how should I do this securely?" questions — acting as an accessible first point of contact for AppSec.
* Contribute to secure coding guidelines, developer\-facing checklists, and language\- or framework\-specific guidance documents.
* Support delivery of developer security awareness and training content (e.g., lunch\-and\-learns, secure coding labs, onboarding modules).



**Collaboration and Communication** 



* Partner with engineering, platform, DevOps, and operations teams across global locations to support AppSec initiatives.
* Communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly and constructively to developers and engineering managers.
* Produce clear, audit\-friendly documentation of triage decisions, exceptions, and remediation tracking.
* Continuously develop technical skills through structured mentorship, hands\-on practice, and self\-directed learning.



**Qualifications:** 




**Required:** 



* 0–2 years of experience in application security, software development, security engineering, or a closely related technical role (internships, co\-ops, capstone projects, and CTF participation count).
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of common application vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10\) and a foundational understanding of how they manifest in modern web and API applications.
* Reading\-level proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go) sufficient to follow code, understand control/data flow, and discuss findings credibly with developers.
* Familiarity with version control (Git), code review workflows, and CI/CD pipeline concepts.
* Foundational understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, and input validation concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and willingness to dig into technical evidence.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated curiosity and self\-driven learning — the role expects rapid growth in AppSec depth over the first 12–18 months.



**Preferred:** 



* Hands\-on exposure to AppSec tooling categories (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, container scanning) through coursework, internships, labs, or personal projects.
* Familiarity with threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE) and frameworks such as OWASP ASVS, OWASP SAMM, or NIST SSDF.
* Exposure to cloud\-native development and security concepts (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, IaC).
* Awareness of AI/ML application security considerations, including risks associated with AI\-assisted development practices.
* Participation in CTFs, bug bounty programs, security research, or open\-source security contributions.
* Industry certifications such as Security\+, GIAC GFACT/GSEC, or similar entry\-level certifications (or active progress toward them).
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare).

* Optimize performance, security, and scalability of microservices and distributed systems.
* Ensure best practices in software development, including code quality, modularization, and maintainability.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Effective communication skills for collaboration with technical and non\-technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Knowledge of Serverless Architecture.

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and delivery of high\-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.

* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
